— So what are you complaining about? That's exactly what I gave you!
A friend once told me: 'Stop being lazy — go to the Maldives!' Well... the only thing standing between me and the Maldives is my laziness.

Two mountaineers finally reached the summit of Everest. One of them, catching his breath, asks the other:
— So, did you end up taking that apartment swap?
— No way! Fifth floor with no elevator — do I look crazy to you?!

A man on the bus lets out a loud fart, then immediately nods toward the little boy next to him:
— Well, would you look at that — such a tiny kid, but sounds like an elephant!
A woman nearby speaks up:
— Excuse me, but that was YOU who did it!
— Can you believe her?! I'm covering for her, and she's pointing the finger at me!
After his mother-in-law's funeral, Pete was walking home. Suddenly a brick fell right in front of him from a rooftop. He looked up at the sky and quietly said: "Well, mom... I see you made it."

Spent the weekend at grandma's. She made my favourite chicken soup with dumplings. Grandma: 'Eat up, sweetheart, the chicken is fresh — I chopped one this morning.' Me: 'How did you pick which one?' Grandma: 'Well, I noticed one walking around looking sad, so I gave it the axe.' That's when I decided I'd never walk around looking sad at grandma's place…

Walking my daughter to kindergarten, she briefs me on the local gossip: "Diana's mom wants to gain weight." I sigh: "That's life — some want to gain weight, others want to lose it..." Then I think they probably talk about me there too, so I tell her: "Just don't say anything about me to anyone, okay?" She nods earnestly: "Sure, Mom. I won't tell anyone you want to lose weight. Let everyone think you just want to stay fat!"

A man walks into a pharmacy: "Give me something for greediness." The pharmacist looks puzzled: "Does such a thing even exist?" The man pulls a huge list of medications out of his pocket and says: "Look — it says right here: 'Take one tablet three times a day.' Could I get something cheaper that still works?"

On the subway, a guy was standing by the doors holding an iPhone 11 box. When the announcement 'Doors closing' came on, some dude snatched the box and vanished into the crowd. The doors shut, the train left. What the owner said next cracked everyone up: 'You bastard, they stole my hamster!'

— Hey, where would you rather be: by the sea or in the forest?
— At the sea, obviously! Are you booking us a vacation?!
— No, I'm just picking an air freshener for the bathroom...

— What do you want most right now?
— I want everything to be like it was before...
— For us to be together again?
— No. For me to have never known you existed!

***

— Describe your life in two words.
— What for?!

— Honey, what are you going to order?
— I want exactly what that woman at the next table is having: lobster, caviar, Peking duck, and a glass of wine.
— Perfect. I'll go ask her to dance, and you eat everything while she's gone.

Coming home after dinner at his mother-in-law's, the husband says to his wife:
— Why did you never tell me you have a sister?
— What sister?! I don't have any sister! What are you on about?
— Then who was your mom talking about all evening, going on about "my darling" and "my darling"?
What did our parents do to keep themselves entertained before the internet was invented? I asked my 11 brothers and sisters — none of them know either.

Grandma came to visit and sat down at the table, eating heartily. Her grandson ran up and asked:
— Grandma, who are you eating for?
— What do you mean, for myself, of course.
— That's odd... Dad said you eat for three.

A husband comes home and tells his wife:
— Honey, I've got two pieces of news — one good, one bad. Which first?
— The good one!
— I won a million in the lottery today!
— Wow, that's amazing! And the bad one?
— I told my best friend about it.
— So what's bad about that?
— He's coming tomorrow to borrow money.
A husband disappeared into his garage every day for five years. His wife finally cracked and went to see what he was hiding. She walks in — and it's just a garage.
Never get angry at anyone — anger makes your hands shake, and your aim goes off.

A group was driving to the cabin and brought along a six-year-old with a water pistol — he soaked everyone, so they took it away and he had a meltdown. Right then a cop pulls them over. The kid's bawling. The officer asks, "Why are you crying?" The kid screams, "THEY'VE GOT A GUUUN!!!" The next five minutes, everyone was face-down on the ground with their hands behind their heads. — Gotta love kids.

A wife cuddles up to her husband: "Tell me honestly, is my hair pretty?" "Pretty." "And my eyes?" "Pretty too." "And my nose?" "And your nose..." Suddenly the husband freezes and asks suspiciously: "Wait a second — why aren't you showing up in the mirror then?"

Only people from big families will get this: the youngest is splashing happily with mom and dad, the middle kid is fighting for survival alone, and the oldest hasn't been missed in weeks — still down there on the pool floor.
A husband tells his wife, "Honey, I've decided we're never going to argue again!" She snaps back, "Oh, would you listen to him, 'he decided'... Since when did anyone ask me?!"

An Australian farmer walks up to a pond and sees a group of girls skinny-dipping in it. They spot him and yell, "Get lost! We're not coming out of the water until you leave!" The farmer calmly replies, "Relax, I'm not here for you. I just came to feed my crocodile."

A guy comes home to his village on vacation and asks his dad for a rifle — he wants to go hunt a wolf. His dad's shocked: "Your grandfather hunted wolves with a spear, I did it with a bow, and you want a rifle?!" But the guy insists, grabs the rifle, and heads out into the fields. Suddenly a wolf appears and lets out a terrifying howl. The guy panics, drops the rifle, and sprints home. "Hunting didn't really work out," he says, "I kind of lost the rifle on the way." His dad just sighs: "Well, that's it then... Used to be the wolf only had a spear and a bow. Now he's got a rifle too!"

When I got lost at five, my brilliant plan was to head back to the bus stop and hop on a trolleybus. A kind woman spotted me and took me straight to the police station. A young officer was typing away on a typewriter while I bombarded him with questions. When my panicked mom finally showed up, they told her I was an unusually curious kid — in two hours I never asked the same question twice.

A woman was rushed to the hospital after grabbing a can of expanding foam instead of her hair spray and giving herself quite the "hairdo." The real casualties, though, were two doctors, an entire ambulance crew, and a nurse — all nearly collapsed from uncontrollable laughter.

Turns out we finally figured out how to control the weather. Wash your car — it'll rain. Bring an umbrella — it won't. Book your vacation for summer — summer turns cold and rainy. Buy skis in the fall — winter turns out snowless.

My four-year-old was watching cartoons with her talking doll when the doll started whining, "Mommy, I'm hungry." My kid rolled her eyes, muttered something like "seriously, again?", stomped to the kitchen, grabbed a banana, shoved it at the doll, and went right back to her show. I think I'll be waiting a while for grandkids.

My son swipes candy from mom, who doesn't allow sweets, and stashes it with grandpa for "safekeeping." Then later he casually asks grandpa for a candy, and of course grandpa hands one over. The kid basically invented a candy money-laundering scheme. And people still call children innocent.

I was sitting alone on a park bench, enjoying the quiet and the fresh air. Suddenly some guy comes over and sits down next to me. I turn to him and go: "Did you bring the money?" You should've seen him bolt.

A friend of mine got curious where retirees are all rushing to during rush hour. So he picked one grandma and tailed her. Turns out she rode to the very last stop… then got right back on the same bus to go home.

My whole arm is covered in tattoos. One day I picked up my son from school, and his teacher saw me and started going on about how anyone could live their whole life with an arm like that. I didn't know what to say, but my son jumped in: "Well, you've managed to live your whole life with that face."

When the cleaning lady was rude to me, I told her she was doing an amazing job and I was really grateful. And when my dad once complained I greeted him too coldly, I just wrapped him in a big hug and asked, "Better now?" It's always funny watching people freeze when their attitude smashes straight into your kindness.

— Are you good at math?
— Just ask me.
— If you cut a cake into three equal pieces, each one is 1/3, right?
— Yeah.
— But 1/3 as a decimal is 0.333... forever?
— Yes.
— So where did that last little crumb go?
— Are you dumb? It's stuck to the knife.

Moms today: "Just running to the store for 30 minutes, called a babysitter, don't worry, call if you need anything." Moms back in the day: "I'm off for a three-day shift, don't open the door for anyone or thieves will come and kill you. Don't miss me too much."

A genie appears to a man and says: "I'll grant you any wish, but your enemy will get the exact same thing, doubled. So what'll it be?" The man thinks for a second and says: "Blood pressure 120 over 80, all 32 teeth straight and healthy, both eyes perfect, and a temperature of 98.6."

– Doc, my wife keeps complaining that I smell!
– You need to wash more often.
– But I already wash a lot!
– How exactly?
– I start from my head and go down as far as I can. Then from my feet, up as far as I can.
– Got it. Go home and wash that spot in the middle!

A boy runs home from school yelling, "Mom, our whole class went to a pig farm today! There was this huge fat pig there — even fatter and bigger than you!" Hearing that, Mom bursts into tears. Her youngest kid runs over, hugs her neck, and comforts her: "Don't cry, Mommy, he's lying — there's no pig in the world fatter than you!"

A wife comes home from her night shift and asks, "Honey, why is the table so spotless? Did you not even eat?" From the cage, the parrot pipes up: "Don't clean it so well, Sveta, or my sillyrrr wife won't believe I skipped dinner! She won't believe it!"
A guy wanted to know where retirees go during rush hour. He followed one grandma — she rode all the way to the last stop... then got right back on to head home.

A guy in the supermarket asked for the complaint book. The women wrote: "Everything's great, all wonderful!" Then the man signed off: "The guys here are absolute Hercules! Everything's perfect, my mood's fantastic, my wife's gorgeous, and honestly, I'm pretty amazing myself!"

Went for my medical check to renew my driver's license yesterday. The psychiatrist asks: "How much is a quarter of an hour?" I say "fifteen minutes." He says "Wrong." I try again: "Twenty-five?" — "Correct, here's your paperwork." I just grabbed my documents and left. You don't argue with these guys.

A guy sold his car in the pettiest way possible — he scrawled on the rear window: "Buy me! My owner fell for someone else, but I've always been loyal and reliable. I can't watch this betrayal anymore... here's his number" — and left his ex-owner's actual phone number for the world to see.
Kangaroos look cute and harmless, but really they're loud, pretty aggressive, and expensive to keep. And the one on the left in the photo? I know absolutely nothing about it.
A woman comes to confession: "Father, I've sinned again!" The priest, rubbing his forehead: "Come on, Mary, how long is this going to go on — same story every single week..."
I knocked over a flower pot in the kitchen, and my cat saw it happen. So I had to spray myself with water too — to prove the law applies to everyone.

By the way, my mom's friend's daughter is just as impressive as her son: got married at 21 and immediately had triplets, earned two degrees at once while working remotely, bakes mystery pies to order, somehow took exams during labor, and her kids' first words were the formula E=mc², the irregular verbs table, and "grandma knows best."

Oxford scientists announced that the wider a woman's hips, the smarter she is — all thanks to Omega-3 fatty acids. And there she sits on a bench thinking: "Who would've guessed! And here I was dieting all this time, almost lost all my brains!"

Sitting on the bus, a guy next to me is holding a ginger kitten, kissing it on the forehead the whole time. So sweet, I think. My eyesight's not great, so I put on my glasses to get a better look — turns out it's not a kitten at all, it's a meat pie.

I never understood why they print cute little animals on diapers. Babies don't even look at them — the slogans should be for the parents instead: "You'll sleep again someday," "Don't lose hope," and "This side faces the enemy!"
American billionaire Mark Davis, 69, says his girlfriend Hayden Hopkins, 26, fell for his smile — and had no clue he was a billionaire.
Found out the phrase reads exactly the same forwards and backwards — a perfect palindrome. Too brilliant to be legal: "This is illegal, I'm calling the police!"

When you've already said "wow" ten times, "yeah" eight times, "no way" five times, and "that's rough" about four times — and they're still going: the trick is never to say "no way, really?" because that just fuels storytellers to keep going.
We got the cat an automatic feeder with a timer. Now he just sits on top of it 24/7, meditating for that magic click.

Went to a job interview today. The HR gave me a laptop and said, "Try selling it to me." So I took the laptop, walked out of the room — and just left the building. Half an hour later she calls me, totally frantic: "Bring that laptop back right now!" I said, "Two hundred bucks and it's yours."
The TV says: "Want to change your life? Just get off the couch!" The guy with the remote replies: "Scam. Changing the channel."

Being a good mom is basically an impossible task. Work a lot — who's raising the kid? Don't work — you're lazy. Watch them closely — you're smothering them. Give them space — you're careless. Meanwhile dads have it easy: kid's alive, you remember their name? Congrats, you're father of the year. I want to be a dad instead.

A woman goes to the doctor: "Doctor, everything hurts, literally everything!" The doctor asks: "Do you smoke?" "Quit." "Drink?" "Quit." "See men?" "Quit that too." "Well, it's clear — you have a bad case of QTS." "What's that?" "Quit Too Soon."
My wife asked me to take a photo of her with the dog. I did — now she hasn't spoken to me for a week.
A cop asks the new inmate, "So what'd you get locked up for?" She says, "For being locked up, obviously." He clarifies, "No, I mean — what did you actually do?" She goes, "Well... I got locked up."

Trust me, you need to hear this story. My sister feeds the stray cats in the yard. One day a cat showed up wearing a little tag. She figured he was lost, opened the tag, and found a note with a phone number. She called. A girl picked up.
- Hello?
- I'm calling about the cat...
- The cat's not home right now. Have him call back when he gets in.

In Germany, an old lady switched off her roommate's ventilator twice — the humming noise was bugging her.
"Did you see what time it is?"
"Then just turn off that dang computer thingy!"
Nobody ever asked why the guy always carried a pack of sleeping pills. The girl wasn't bothered at all — she invited him over anyway.

After finding out her husband was cheating, the wife printed his mistress's face, stuck it on a watermelon, and put it in the fridge. He opened the fridge door — and ended up in the hospital with a heart attack.

A guy's selling his car — and on the rear window it's practically a confession: "Buy me! My owner fell for someone else, but I was always loyal and reliable, never let him down once. I can't watch this betrayal... here's his number: 8-913-240-1100." Man, I almost teared up.

Imagine you have to live in this house for exactly one month. You'll have food, water, and firewood for heat — but no internet, no TV, no cell signal at all. On your last day, you get fifty thousand dollars. Would you do it?

This is the grandma I'm going to become. Emergency call: "Our grandma, 98 years old, went mute, can't say a word!" The doctor shows up and finds granny in the kitchen calmly smoking. "Ma'am, they said you completely stopped talking?" "I talk just fine!" "But your family said you went mute." "Why would I waste words on those idiots?"
Giving away a kitten to a loving home... house-trained, uses the litter box, only eats meat... oh right, forgot to mention — it's a tiger 🙂

Medical school, first lecture after the break. The professor walks in:
"Ah, springtime... everyone's falling in love. Back when I was young, a buddy and I went to a club, and we both liked the same girl. She picked him, not me. So I was left out in the cold. And he... was left without a nose. Today's lecture topic: 'Syphilis and its complications.'"
Kids today: "Wanna go to the seaside, honey?" "Nah, it's too hot there." Me at their age: "Where were you all day?" "Swimming in the pond. Oh, and by the way, Lyokha drowned."

My four-year-old little brother wouldn't stop jumping on the bed, so to calm him down I told him: "Keep that up and your belly will get round like Dad's!" He stopped instantly. Later, out on a walk, he spots a pregnant woman and yells at the top of his lungs: "So, all that jumping finally caught up with you, huh?" You should've seen her face.
Yesterday my wife and I wallpapered the kitchen. She told me off nine times, I told her off four times, and we got divorced twice. Still, we're happy with how it turned out!

If you were born in the '80s, grew up in the '90s, and made it to the 2020s... you've lived through 4 decades, 2 centuries, and 2 millennia — and you're still not even 40! Plus you managed to live in two different countries without ever moving.
The son was told to bring a craft project to kindergarten. Dad didn't disappoint — he spent the whole weekend building him an entire choir out of cans! Father of the year!

I love early spring: I'm bundled up in a puffer jacket, some girl runs past in a leather jacket, a dress and sandals, a fancy lady struts by in a fur coat, and off in the distance an old man is sunbathing in his underwear!
When you read "find a taxi" backwards and it somehow sounds illegal: "This is illegal, I'm calling the police!"

Walking back from the country house with mom and my little brother to catch the bus. At one fence a furious dog kept barking like crazy — there was a gap it kept sticking its snout through, all chewed up around the edges. My brother, who's 9, suddenly goes: "Nah, she's friendly!" "How do you know?" "I stuck my face in there and she didn't bite me, she licked me!" You should've seen mom's face.
As a kid you never got why adults loved having a garden house so much — and now you're dreaming of your own place to grow veggies, grill some skewers, and stare into space for hours.
She asked, "Wanna come over?" He said, "Sorry, busy today." Truth is, he had zero plans — his socks just had holes all over them.

A little girl asks her grandma, "Where did we come from?" Grandma says, "God made us." The girl says, "But Dad says we came from monkeys." Grandma just smiles: "Well, your dad's talking about his own relatives — I'm talking about mine."
The way my kitchen stares at me every time I go get tea and cookies for the 9th time today

Leopard Cleopatra and her Shadow

Turns out these two are actually a couple: his name is Saya, which means "shadow" in Hindi, and hers is Cleopatra.

An absolutely stunning pair
The travel agency swore it was "just a five-minute walk to the beach"...
I poured a fresh concrete path in the yard... sent the kids to grandma's, chained up the dog, locked the cat inside. Thought I'd covered every angle. But out of nowhere a turtle shows up!!!

Either I'm losing my mind, or that sheep in the sack is walking on two legs!
— Relax, you're not crazy. They just trimmed off the extra parts.
On a crowded bus, two women are yelling at a tipsy guy: "I'll show you!" — "I'll give it to you!" The guy just smiles: "Ladies, I honestly can't decide which one of you to pick..."

70 women in Britain got married to trees, and it's not as crazy as it sounds. On Spike Island in Bristol, they used the ceremony to stop a developer from cutting down the forest for luxury housing. Since the trees are now technically "married," the land can't be touched. Forest saved, brides win.

My mom and I had my two nieces over for the weekend, and they wanted to play underwater kingdom. I got cast as the shark, they were fish, and mom got cast as coral — meaning her entire job was to sit on the couch. I have a lot of feelings about that woman's genius, mostly respect. Because who lives at the bottom of the ocean? Mom the coral, deep in the couch cushions!

"Doctor, what do I write as cause of death?" "Write: coronavirus." "What coronavirus, the guy's got two gunshot wounds and seven stab wounds!" "Doesn't matter, write: coronavirus with underlying conditions!"
I signed up to lay pipes, not haul boulders — but apparently someone thought it's the same job

Asked my husband to roast a chicken for dinner. An hour later I call everyone to the table — and instead of dinner, there's a curvy little lady in a crispy bikini sitting on the tray. He swears he cooked it fair and square, but that chicken clearly decided to show off.

For fifteen years I've been my ex-husband's best friend. We have lunch together, I know all his mistresses and his new wife. He recently sold his downtown apartment, and to keep his young wife from getting a cent in the divorce, he asked me to hold the money in my account for a while. Tomorrow I'm flying off to buy my dream house by the sea. Shouldn't have broken my heart all those years ago.

After a rough patch of turbulence, the flight attendant calms everyone down: "Why is everyone screaming?! Just an air pocket! Okay, everyone's fine now, let go of the seat, it's over. Breathe deep... wait, what happened to you?" - "I pooped my pants!!!" - "Happens to the best of us, we'll find you new trousers. Everyone calm? Great, I'll go check on the rest of the passengers..."
In elementary school kids brag: "I've got an iPhone X!" — "Ha, I've got the XR!" By high school it's: "What episode of that cartoon are you on?" — "I'm rewatching an old one right now."
Sweden built a road that charges electric cars while they drive. Big deal — our roads dismantle your car into spare parts while you're still driving on them.
Bought a British kitten yesterday, but my husband turned out to be allergic. Anyone want him? He's cute: 6 feet tall, dark-haired, works as a manager.

- Ivan, no more drinking starting today!
- Says who?!
- The doctor forbade it.
- What doctor?
- Me!
- Natasha, you're a vet!
- Shut it, you animal!
My husband once decided to be helpful and washed the dishes. He really shouldn't have... Turns out that particular "skill" runs strictly on the male side of the family.
I'll just use her face cream, she'll never notice. She noticed, alright — now he's six feet under.

My friend hyped me up before getting on the bus: "Okay, this is the big moment, don't mess it up." I get on, sit down, and instead of just telling the driver loudly where to stop, I chicken out. Next thing I know, I missed my stop... and ended up in a whole other country.

Today I got a text: "Your boyfriend is cheating on you, and not just with one girl!" Now I'm stuck wondering since when exactly I have a boyfriend, how long we've been together, and what I'm supposed to tell my husband.

If you catch your husband's shady messages, don't rush into a scandal. Screenshot everything, make an anonymous account, and threaten to send it all to his family. Then ask for a nice chunk of cash to stay quiet...
In a courtroom in Russia, they hid an anonymous witness behind a bedsheet and disguised his voice with an ordinary bucket. Comment: "Russian-style witness protection program. Budget: 2 billion."

A teacher scolds a boy: "You can't even read — what's going to become of you?" Thirty years later, that same guy — now a traffic cop — pulls a car over: "Afternoon. That's a 500 fine, your plate's unreadable."
Think you're having a bad day? Remember that woman who stood in line behind three mannequins.
I asked my husband to grab some plain slippers for the cabin. This is what he came back with... Now I have no idea what to do with them!
The son-in-law asks his mother-in-law, "Mom, do you know how to play chess?" She replies, "If I did, would I have handed my queen over to some horse?"
I asked my husband to take a photo of me by the sea. Two days later I still haven't forgiven him — the picture turned out way too honest.
Dad thinks that if he shows up fishing with that old lure every fish in the lake has already seen, they'll react like: "Ugh, oh my god, how embarrassing."
My kid drew a cat and got an F — the teacher wrote "cats like this don't exist." Meet the actual, real-life cat he copied.
"What do you do for a living?" "I pull people out." "How do they react?" "They scream." "Has anyone ever punched you for it?" "No, not yet — they're still too small. I'm an obstetrician."

Imagine if apartments worked like cats: you buy one, and a couple years later it's had a fling with the neighbor's place and had a litter of baby apartments. Or you're walking down the street and there's a little studio getting soaked in the rain. You tuck it under your coat, bring it home, feed it some fresh laminate flooring — and two months later it's grown into a three-bedroom.
My physics teacher, when I try to explain that a pregnant mare gallops twice as fast because she's got two horsepower inside her:

Police are hunting the prankster who painted a stray dog to look like a tiger — the whole neighborhood is doing a double take! One commenter wrote: "Honestly, judging by his face, the dog's totally into it"
"Why haven't you gotten married yet, Olya?" "I placed an ad: 'Looking for a loyal life partner.' Only the dog shelter called."

The teacher says: "Little Johnny, you wrote in your essay that you like a boy in our class and he even kissed you, is that true?" That's when Johnny realized just how risky it is to copy off Mary's homework!

A nurse tells an elderly woman in a wheelchair, "I've got wonderful news for your grandson." The grandma asks hopefully, "Am I going to live?" The nurse replies, "No, but he'll soon have his own apartment."
The ancient Romans never had a single diploma, yet their roads lasted thousands of years. Then the trained professionals showed up — and a year later the asphalt looked like Swiss cheese.

In Germany, an old lady unplugged her roommate's ventilator twice because the humming noise annoyed her.
— Did you check the time?
— Just turn off that computer!

"Hi, I took out a three-million loan from you, but my business went under. Which window do I go to now?"
"We're on the eighth floor, any window's fine. Except the third one on the left — that's where I park my car."
You don't need to spend half your life with a woman to figure her out — just look at her school photo.

Finally got my grandkids, now I'm not afraid to go... Actually wait, first I need to walk them to kindergarten. Fine, then I'll see them through school too, and that's it. Hmm, but I really want to see their graduation, and then someone has to marry them off — guess that's me again! And who's going to babysit the great-grandkids? Also me. Looks like I'll have to live to a hundred!
My husband stumbled home drunk at 3 a.m. I was way too lazy to get up and deal with it, so I just pointed a laser pointer at him — and the cat handled the rest.

5-star review: "They cuffed me so professionally and gently, then walked me straight into the patrol car. Clean inside, tidy, no drama on the ride at all. Highly recommend getting arrested by these guys." — "Appreciate it, bro!"

People heading to the country house aren't passengers — they're an expedition. They don't care how they get there: bus, train, tractor, a motorcycle with a sidecar, a cart, a boat. The only requirement is fitting in the seedlings, the mother-in-law, and the hope that this time they'll actually get some rest.

When I was 13, I was head over heels for a girl from the next yard. I brought her daisies, smuggled candy out of the house for her, and she just kept leading me on. One day, after another rejection, I sat on a bench feeling sorry for myself. A nine-year-old girl walked up, shyly held out a lollipop and said, "Don't be sad, you'll find your girl someday." That was 11 years ago. I'm getting married soon — to that very nine-year-old.

I got on the bus at the last stop, waiting for it to leave. A mom gets on with her little girl, the kid sits down, smooths out her dress, and announces grandly: "Driver, onward, we're off to the ball!" Mom turns bright red, and the whole bus nearly falls over laughing when the driver deadpans back: "Yes, Your Majesty."

"Honey, what should I get you tomorrow?"
"Wow, put me on the spot... I don't know. I really love the sound of a text saying money just landed on my card."
This ambulance has a sign on the back: "Kind Doctor" up top, and below it: "Go ahead and pass — someone's waiting for your kidneys!" Followed by an honest little note: "Ouch, that hurts."

A son tells his dad, "Pop, I'm getting married!" "Who to, son?" "Valka from down the street." "Oh, don't marry her, kid... truth is, I sinned in my youth, she's your sister." "Fine, I'll marry Olya the neighbor then." "Can't, she's your sister too." "Then Manya from next door!" "Also your sister..." Finally the mom yells from the kitchen, "Just marry whoever you want, son, you're not even his kid anyway!"

Dozed off on the bus. Opened my eyes and nearly had a heart attack — a lady behind me was wearing a giant fluffy hood, and half-asleep I was sure it was some hairy monster. Ladies, please have a little mercy on us!
A woman to her climbing partner, lying on a portaledge halfway up a cliff: "If I start snoring, just give me a little push..."

When the hotel listing says "5 minutes to the beach" — but it's really a thousand steps down a cliff. As one comment put it: trip once and you'll make it to the sea in five seconds flat, straight into it.

A three-year-old hands her dad a pear: "Daddy, eat it!" He takes the pear and starts eating it himself. She stares at him, hurt, and insists again: "Daddy, eat it!" Confused, he eats even faster. Now she's nearly in tears: "Daddy! EAT IT!" He says, baffled, "I am eating it!" She replies: "Daddy, get a knife and cut it into pieces for me!"
My wife started taking gymnastics classes. I walked in on her practicing by accident — and honestly, it took me a minute to figure out what was where.
Here's what happens when you spin around too fast!

A father and son went fishing. The son says, "Dad, I need to poop." The dad says, "We're out in nature, buddy, you can go anywhere, nobody's going to yell at you." The kid wanders off and comes back a few minutes later. Dad asks, "So, where'd you go?" Kid: "In the car — no mosquitoes in there."

My wife threw a fit because I called tomato salad a vegetable salad — apparently tomatoes are technically a berry. A few days later she asked me to grab something with berries from the store. Couldn't resist — I brought home a can of tomato paste.

First one's a boy, fine. Second one's a boy too. We wanted a girl, but no luck. Got pregnant a third time, really hoping for a girl. Another boy... "Don't worry," my husband said, "later they'll bring you so many girls to choose from!"
Store: pay an extra $5 and we'll deliver your purchase. Dad: nah, I'll manage myself.

Eight-year-old me, 2 a.m.: "Mom, we have to dress nice for school tomorrow and my white shirt's a wrinkled mess." Mom, without a word, gets up to iron it. Back in the day you'd never dare say that out loud — you'd have gotten an earful.

A guy is being prepped for surgery, and the doctor casually lays out the prices: nurses get 10 bucks each, the surgeon gets 200, and the anesthesiologist gets 500. The patient can't believe it: "500 bucks just to put me to sleep?!" The doctor shrugs: "Putting you to sleep is the cheap part, that's only 10 bucks. The other 490 is for waking you back up."
The grannies by the entrance called Oksana a junkie and a hooker, and she didn't even mind. "As long as they never find out I'm actually a doctor," Oksana thought.
A woman walks into a car dealership. "I'd like to buy a car from you." The salesman asks, "What model?" She says, "I'm not a model, I'm an accountant. But thanks for the compliment!"

A "hopeless situation" today: you cracked your phone and now your parents are going to kill you. A "hopeless situation" in my childhood: that concept didn't exist — everyone was just outside kicking a ball around.

Need a business idea? Here it is: open a gym inside a warehouse. People will actually pay you to unload trucks. Coach Mike just yells, "Alright team, next set: dumpling curls, let's load that trailer at gate three!" Let's go!
Thanks for the heads-up, Lena! Her rear windshield has a sticker that says: "Caution, Lena is driving! God help you all!"
I've been through fire, water, and everything else — nothing fazes me anymore. Except walking past my building entrance. That's basically running a gauntlet of judgment!
She was worried her friend might show up in the same dress — never imagined it'd be the tablecloth matching instead.

A patient asks the doctor how to cure her condition. He says, "Let me just google it." She goes, "Wait, then why don't I just do that myself?" The doctor shakes his head: "Nope, no self-diagnosing on my watch."

When your son is a mathematician. He writes his mom a birthday card: "Mom! Happy birthday, I wish you happiness, joy, fewer nerves, and living to 100. Remaining: 64 years." Then signs it: "Countdown initiated, mom."

The doctor examines his patient:
"You have a terrible cough. Do you smoke?"
"I do."
"And drink?"
"Sometimes..."
"You need to quit both immediately!"
"So what, I'm just supposed to cough instead?!"

I was in the library and saw a guy sobbing over his textbook. Then his alarm went off — and he instantly stopped crying and calmly started reading. Now that's what I call time management before finals.
Last night, pretty drunk, I picked up two gorgeous girls and took them home. This morning I wake up and it's two completely different faces. Guess someone swapped them overnight.
Residents of an apartment building in Lipetsk nearly missed work — their entrance had literally "peeled off" the building.

Putting my five-year-old son to bed, and suddenly he asks: "Dad, is it true boys die before girls?" I ask where he heard that - his friend at daycare told him. I say yeah, statistically that's often true. He looks me dead in the eyes, so serious my heart skipped a beat... then says: "Then please teach Mom how to download games on the tablet."
Bought some winter boots. Now I get skipped straight to the front of every line — one look at my bare feet in them and people just step aside.

At a medical checkup, the psychiatrist shows me an inkblot and asks, "What do you see here?" I say, "A tired, lonely man worn down by idiots, a boring job, and life's endless unfairness." He looks at me sadly and asks, "No, I mean... in the picture."

My achievements are just as invisible as the pug in this photo.
— Where's the pug, damn it?
— Right there, the little rascal, peeking through the hole in the armrest!

Over coffee, a guy asks a girl what car she drives. She says, "Red, with a horse." He sighs dreamily, "Mmm... Ferrari." Turns out it's a beat-up red car literally being pulled down the road by an actual horse.

I, Maria, went to the store with the most honest intentions — just to buy some groceries. But the moment I spotted a cop at the entrance, something snapped in me, and I just walked out with them for free.
I can't figure out where people with work experience even come from, if nobody hires you without experience.

A woman walks into a car dealership and says, "I'd like to buy a car from you." The salesman asks, "Which model?" She blushes and replies, "Oh no, I'm not a model, I'm an accountant. But thanks for the compliment anyway))"

Three friends checked into a hotel on the 45th floor, and were told the elevator shuts off after midnight. That evening they had a few drinks at dinner and came back past midnight — so they had to hike up the stairs. To keep things interesting, they split the climb into three parts: one would tell jokes, another would sing, and the third would tell scary stories. The first two stretches flew by, laughing and singing. Then it's the third guy's turn to scare them on the final fifteen floors. He starts grimly: "Let me tell you the scariest story ever. We forgot to grab the room key from the front desk..."

I still can't stop thinking about the eye doctor who treated my infection and said, "If it hurts, rinse with boiled water. Now look at me closely, because I need you to understand — water that was boiled and then cooled down. NOT boiling water. Do you understand me?" I'm truly grateful to that man for making sure I wouldn't pour scalding water straight into my eyes, since apparently that's exactly how smart he thinks I am.
My husband stumbled in at 3 a.m., completely wasted. I was way too lazy to get up and yell at him, so I just pointed a laser pointer at his face — and the cat handled the rest.
The doctor asks, "Where does it hurt?" The patient says, "Right here, when I press it, it really hurts." The doctor pulls his hand back: "Then don't press it. That'll be $150."

Housewife tip: a one-ingredient cake recipe — quick, easy, and delicious! You'll only need one thing: money. Just take the money, drive to the store, and the cake is ready. Enjoy!

"No matter how many times I try this recipe, I somehow always end up with beer and fish instead."
"Try using different money. If you still get beer, try a different store."

At the maternity ward, a doctor tells one dad: "Congratulations, twins!" The guy beams: "What a coincidence — I own a company called 'Two Eagles'!" Another dad gets told: "You've got triplets!" He's thrilled too: "No way, my company is 'Three Nuts'!" A third father just goes pale and says nothing. The nurse asks: "Are you okay?" He mutters: "My company is called 'Seven Dwarfs'..."

"How did you find out your wife was cheating?"
"I told her a joke, and the idiot hiding in the closet burst out laughing."
I, Maria, went into the store with the most honest intentions — just to buy groceries. But the moment I spotted a police officer at the entrance, my inner rebel woke up and I stole everything.
The instructor asks his student: "What do those signs mean?" The student glances up: "Forty kids are running."
You don't need years together to figure out a woman — sometimes one look at her childhood photo says it all.
You buy an apartment with a sea view, and a year later you get a view of the neighboring building, because your building decided to lean in for a closer look.

A bee stung my mother-in-law right on the tongue. She's in the hospital now — tongue swollen, lips too, and she lost four front teeth. Barely survived. I'm scared to even imagine what would've happened if it hadn't taken me three tries to kill that bee with a shovel...
Beautiful! Now all it needs is a traffic light.
The doctor asks the patient, "How are you feeling?" She's amazed: "Incredible! What did you give me?" The doctor replies, "We just let you sleep." The patient: "Wow!"

She texts: "I won't beat around the bush, I met a man. His name's Boris and he's wonderful. Hard to admit, but I think I've fallen for him. I promised to be honest with you." He replies: "Nastya, you're killing me. We already have two cats." — "Fine, send a pic"... and it's a photo of the cat.

When I'm old, I want a friend I can call up and yell, "Hey, you old fossil, where are we blowing our pension today?!" And she just answers, "I'm in for anything except the cemetery and the heart pills!"
You can tell right away this bar owner has a great sense of humor — the barstools are shaped like animal legs.
Dogs that chase cars are the souls of fired traffic cops.

My boss brought her five-year-old daughter to the office. The kid runs around checking everything out, then walks up to me and asks, dead serious: "Are you guys my mom's slaves?" I burst out laughing and nod: "Yep, pretty much." She pats my head and solemnly promises: "Don't worry, I'll grow up and set you free." Still waiting, Khaleesi.
The teacher asks, "Ivanova, where's the 500 rubles for the school repair?" She replies, "I didn't break it!"

Dinner time: I've got soup, the cat's got sausage. I drop a piece of chicken from my soup into his bowl and he looks thrilled. I step out for a second to grab my phone, come back — and there's a slice of his sausage floating in my soup. Now that's what I call teamwork.
When the surgeon's in a great mood, he stitches you up so the scar spells out "HA-HA-HA-HA."
I call my son. No answer. A bit later his girlfriend texts: "He's asleep." Without missing a beat I reply: "Asleep with who tonight?" And voilà — twenty missed calls from him. Guess he woke up fast.
She burst into tears when she finally saw his "house with a pool"

A friend of mine dozed off on the bus, resting her head on the shoulder of the guy next to her — who was already asleep too. Like two little lovebirds. Then someone's phone rang loudly nearby. Half-asleep, she thought she was home and mumbled, "Honey, get the door." The guy replied, "Babe, you're on the aisle side, you get it." The whole bus lost it laughing.

My buddies and I stopped by a café just to grab dinner. And, as always, we decided to have a hundred grams each. I walk up to the bartender: "Three hundred-gram shots!" He silently puts three glasses on the counter along with a full, unopened bottle of vodka. I say, "Hey, I asked for three hundred-gram shots!" His answer threw me for a second, and then it hit me — this guy understands customer psychology so well it must send his sales through the roof. He said: "Whatever's left, just bring it back."
Walked out the door, made it to the corner — and completely forgot where I was even going...
Guess what animal this is. — Easy, it's a bee. — Are you serious? Have you ever seen a bee that huge and furry? That's a bumblebee!
My side's been hurting for a week. The doctor asks, "Did a spinning top happen to bite you?" "No..." "Darn, then I have no idea what it is."

Online dating:
"I'm Lena, graduated from Cambridge, just moved back to Russia, my dad's a big-shot banker. And you?"
"I'm Edward, I own two steel plants and a chain of gas stations. Lena, want to grab dinner tonight?"
"Love to! Where?"
"I'm into Eastern cuisine, you?"
"Well... I don't mind."
"Seven o'clock at 'The Palace'?"
"Which bus goes there?"
"The 36 or the 47, but the 47 takes forever."
"I probably can't even squeeze onto the 36. I'll just take the tram."
"Okay, see you there!"
Everyone thinks you're just a sweet old granny — meanwhile you're kicking your leg up on the railing like it's nothing. Still quite the spicy number.
Actually, that's not a dog — it's a rare red furniture beetle. — Rare? Please. It's super common: the Swedish buffet-bug, found in every home with flat-pack furniture.

I'm standing in line at the grocery store. Ahead of me is some working guy, behind me is an ancient granny with a cane. The guy tells the cashier, "Give me a bottle, please..." A beat of silence while she waits for him to say which kind. He catches himself: "Oh wait, no, a loaf. Sorry, slip of the tongue." The granny behind me chimes in: "What, sonny, a loving heart can't be fooled?"
The kids dressed the cat up in a little dress... and dad, grandpa, and three neighbors quit drinking on the spot.

My parents never made me go to school. I'd wake up already late, and my dad would just grin and hand me a shovel, a pitchfork, and chores with the animals — at least I wasn't stuck in class. Same thing the next day. But on day three, dad barely opened his eyes and I was already dressed in the hallway, backpack on, tying my shoes. That's how I learned to love school.

My wife ordered delivery, the courier was supposed to be named Camila. I go downstairs and there's some guy standing there. Figured he's not for me. We just stood there for five minutes, neither of us leaving. Finally I ask: "Are you Camila?" He goes: "Are you Julia?" Turns out he was waiting for the wrong order too. He just grabbed his delivery and left.
My son drew a cat at school and got a failing grade. So I showed the teacher an actual photo of our cat — and the grade instantly became an A.
My wife left a note: "Don't trust the cat, he already ate!" I look at the cat... and somehow I'm sure it's my wife who's lying.

"Dad, can I give you a kiss?"
"No money. Mom already kissed me today."

"Why do you look so rough today?"
"Took some medicine."
"What kind of medicine is that?"
"Hangover-be-gone."

Whenever I'm bored, I call the trust hotline — a nice guy with a soft voice always picks up, and I introduce myself as "Lyubanya" and tell him all my secrets. Yesterday I called and some girl answered instead. I started talking anyway, and after a minute I heard rustling, then that familiar voice: "Give me the phone." And then: "Hello, Lyubanya! So, what's going on with you today!" I felt so warm inside.
You finally start drifting off after a brutal day, and then it hits you: the laundry's still sitting in the washer, and if you don't hang it up right now, it's going to start smelling.

A daughter-in-law calls her mother-in-law: "Mom, my husband and I have a bet — if the kid has an accident, who has to clean it up?" The mother-in-law instantly says: "Well me, of course!" "Great! Because your son just came home drunk and had one. Come on over and clean him up yourself!"

A guy texts his mom: "I've had enough visiting, can you come pick me up?" Mom: "No." "Why not? I've been stuck here four days!" "Because you got married, Dima. That's your home now." What an absolute betrayal.
She screamed at him: "Choose — either me or your cat!" Now he's sitting alone at the table with two glasses of wine, a rose, and the cat. Caption: "Naive. What did she even expect?"
A geometry lesson at home: the cat stretched out in the corner so perfectly that everyone finally got what a cat-angent is.

This pigeon has seen it all. Just watched a six-year-old boy reading a book about how to build a birdhouse — out loud, to actual pigeons. When he finished, he said "you're on your own now" and walked off. That's a future foreman right there!

One night my wife and I hear dishes clinking in the kitchen. I think: we forgot to cover the cutlets, the cat must be at them! I jump up and sprint to the kitchen while my wife yells after me, "Get that thing!" I get there — the cat's fast asleep in the hallway. But you should've seen my mother-in-law scrambling around that kitchen!

- I finally had a son! Last week, can you believe it?! After six daughters — finally a boy! I'm so happy!
- Congrats! Who does he look like?
- No idea yet. We haven't gotten to the face.
"What happened to her?" "She talked to some teenagers in the yard." Now she just sits there muttering: "Chillin'... flexin'... vibin'... cappin'..."
At the market. "How much for the cucumbers?" "A hundred sixty a kilo." "You can shove them, you know where!" "Can't, it's already full of tomatoes — two seventy a kilo."

"Hey, something's dripping under your truck."
"Where?"
Someone wrote on their back windshield: "Sorry if I hit anyone." Meanwhile the guy he just ran over is lying in the road going, "Nah, no worries."

Two buddies are drinking, but the vodka runs out and neither has a penny. The host says, "I'll go print a bit of money." His friend figures it's a joke, but sure enough, there's a little printing press in the next room. They print some bills, go buy more booze, keep drinking. The next day the host gets called in by the authorities: "We got a tip that you're printing money." He replies, "I'm not printing it, it's already sitting in there, the machine just presses it flat." "Then why do you do that?" "So I know who I'm drinking with."

When their son turned four, the wife noticed he looked nothing like her or her husband. They did a DNA test, and sure enough, he wasn't theirs. In tears, she asks her husband how this could happen. He calmly replies: "Remember at the hospital, I brought you the baby and you said he'd wet himself and asked me to swap him? So I went back, put that one down, and grabbed a clean one."
A husband calls his wife: "Honey, be careful, the radio just said some maniac is driving the wrong way on the highway!" She replies: "One? There are thousands of them here!"
A husband is seeing his wife off at the station before her vacation: "Be careful out there, okay?" "Got it! Be careful whenever someone offers."

There was a very old, hard-of-hearing professor at our university. Upperclassmen let us in on a secret: if you just spoke confidently and coherently during the exam, no matter what nonsense you said, he'd give you a good grade. So one guy drew his exam ticket and, straight-faced, launched into a story about his brother serving in the army. We were barely holding back laughter. The professor passed him. A year later, when we were taking another exam with him, he called on that same student and asked with a grin, "So, is your brother back from the army yet? Guess it's your turn now!"

Wife to husband: "Look what a lovely couple our new neighbors are — he's always hugging her, kissing her, grabbing her butt, whispering sweet nothings. Why don't you ever do that with me?" Husband: "Honey, are you out of your mind? I've never even met that woman!"
Dozed off on the bus, woke up and nearly died of fright — a furry creature with eyes staring right at me. Turned out it was just some lady's fuzzy hood. Ladies, please, have a little mercy on us!
She's crying because, according to her, he doesn't put any effort into the relationship. Meanwhile, he has no idea he's even in one.
A husband and wife pass a jewelry store. The wife says, "Sweetie, aren't you ashamed I've worn the same earrings for a whole year?" The husband replies, "Honey, want me to show you my socks instead?"
My wife left her rubber gloves on top of the washing machine. I walked into the dark bathroom and nearly had a heart attack seeing those fingers sticking out.
Snapped this on my way home — the car's only muddy on one side, and right under it someone wrote "This is the wife's side." I can't stop laughing.

When I was about seven, a relative showed me at a family dinner how to twist a champagne cork cage into a tiny chair. Ever since, not a single one of those wire cages gets past me — I turn every one I find into a chair. Every cork is doomed to become furniture!

Went for a medical check to renew my driver's license. The psychiatrist asks: "How much is a quarter of an hour?" I say "15 minutes." "Wrong." "Okay... 25?" "Correct, here are your papers." Turns out he was right — 15 minutes for the appointment plus a 10-minute smoke break. Never argue with a specialist.

A man crawls into the psychiatrist's office with something in his teeth. The doctor coos, "Aww, who's this? A little kitty?" The man crawls to a corner. "A puppy?" He runs his hand along the baseboard and crawls to another corner. "A hedgehog? A turtle, maybe?" Finally the man takes the wire out of his mouth and snaps, "Look, are you gonna let me install the internet or not?!"
It's easy to offend an artist, but understanding their art isn't given to everyone.
Selling a hunting dog. Reason for sale: she just doesn't get the concept of hunting — she sits right next to the prey and stares at it.

I always wanted a pet rat. My boyfriend got me one for Valentine's Day. Yellow rotten teeth, patchy gray fur falling out in clumps, and the second a cat walked into the room it would grab the cage bars ready to fight to the death. Then my dad's friend "opened my eyes" — turns out it wasn't a pet rat at all, just a regular street rat. My boyfriend later admitted he had no money for a gift, so he just caught a rat in the yard and wrapped it up.
Other people: carefully inspect every berry to make sure no bugs snuck in. Me: any speck of dirt in my mouth is basically a free vitamin.

Back in school, this one guy chased after me for years — flowers, love confessions, the works. I always turned him down. Then we grew up, went to college in different cities, and lost touch completely. Today I walk into the gynecologist's office... and there he is. He bursts out laughing and says, "Undress and spread your legs. Your school dreams finally came true!"

A guy wakes up hungover right in a cemetery, early morning, still dark out. Wandering between the graves, he spots a gravedigger digging a hole. He decides to spook him — sneaks up behind and goes "Oooooo." The gravedigger doesn't even flinch, keeps digging. He tries louder: "Ooo-goo-goo-ooo." Still nothing, guy's totally unbothered. He gives up and heads for the exit. Right at the gate, the gravedigger catches up, whacks him full-force with the shovel, and shakes a finger at him: "Walk around the cemetery all you want, just don't cross into MY territory!"
The pole is leaning, the car crashed straight into it, and the globe clearly shows the Earth's curve. Checkmate, flat-earthers!

Popped into the shop and disaster struck — I ran into my old barber. He gave me this sad look and goes: "Hey, I see you're getting your hair cut somewhere else now?" I feel like a total cheater standing there with my shaved sides.
My wife wanted to donate her clothes to poor, starving families. I said if her clothes actually fit them, they can't be that starving. The fight started right away.
Leopards on the hunt for deer

"I must have been blind and deaf when I agreed to marry you!"
"See, honey, look what conditions I cured you of."
Grandmas have gotten so bold, they even broke the bench!
When someone yells "Vasya!" from the yard, always ask which cat they mean.
Bad omen: a black cat crosses your path. Really bad omen: two strange guys walk toward you carrying buckets. But the worst omen of all? A traffic cop waving you over.
Giving away a dog to a good home. Cheerful personality, not picky about food at all — proof attached in the photo.

They ask a sailor, "Were you ever truly terrified?" He says, "Once we were shipping ten thousand talking dolls. We hit a massive storm, the ship tilted hard, and all ten thousand dolls said 'Mama!' at the same time. That's when I lost control of my bowels."

The 90s. I'm a single mom, riding a bus to Poland with my five-year-old daughter. A guy starts flirting with me — I ignore him completely, too tired for romance. So he tries to break the ice through my daughter: "Why is your mom so grumpy?" Just before that I'd whispered to her that I really needed the bathroom. So she announces to the whole bus: "Mom's usually nice, she just really needs to poop right now." Twenty-five years together now, and whenever I start getting annoyed, the whole family teases me: "Need to poop?"

My wife and I are asleep when suddenly we hear something clattering in the kitchen. First thought: we forgot to cover the cutlets, and the cat's in there! I jump up and sprint to the kitchen, wife yelling behind me "get that thing!" I get there and the cat's fast asleep in the hallway. But you should've seen my mother-in-law zipping around that kitchen like lightning.

A student runs into a bearded professor in the hallway and asks, "Excuse me, when you go to sleep, do you tuck your beard under the blanket or leave it on top?" The professor shrugs, "Never really thought about it." A week later the same professor, exhausted with bags under his eyes, grabs the student by the collar and yells, "Because of you I haven't slept in a week — under feels wrong, over feels wrong too!"
Me: Why am I doing this? Brain: Just because.

Had a job interview today. The HR lady handed me a laptop and said, "Go ahead, try to sell it to me." So I took the laptop, walked out of the office — and just went home. Half an hour later she calls me, totally freaking out: "Give the laptop back right now!" I said, "200 bucks and it's yours."

Turns out cats have zero imagination — when the owner leaves for work, the cat genuinely thinks he's just standing behind the front door like an idiot for hours, then walks back in. "Oleg, you've been standing behind that door for seven hours. Are you an idiot, Oleg?"

A blonde had an economy ticket but plopped herself down in business class and flatly refused to move. The flight attendants took turns trying to talk her out of it — no luck. Finally the captain himself stepped in. "Let me handle this," he said, "my wife's a blonde too." He leaned in, whispered something in her ear, and she shot up and walked straight back to her seat. Everyone crowded around him: "What did you tell her?!" He said: "I told her business class doesn't fly to the Maldives."
The kids dressed the cat in a little dress with braids... and now dad, grandpa, and three neighbors have all quit drinking
I love a good thunderstorm in May and a snowstorm in February, but when April makes you wear shorts in the morning and a winter coat by evening, that's just too much.
A therapist's kid never just begs for toys. They ease into it: "Mom, was your childhood hard and lonely too?" That's how therapists' kids operate.

Three blonde friends are chasing a train that's already leaving. Two of them manage to jump on board, but the third stays on the platform, cracking up laughing. The stationmaster asks, confused, "What's so funny?" She replies, "Those two idiots were just seeing me off!"

My kids caught a cold, so I sat them over a pot of potatoes to breathe in the steam. First they complained, then went quiet. I lift the blanket — the pot's empty! Turns out they ate the whole pot of potatoes, skins and all, no salt. Their explanation: "We got bored sitting there."
They say it's hard to look at lips you can't kiss. But try looking at a face you're dying to punch!

Doing homework with my son: "On day one they ate 5 cups of strawberries, on day two 2 cups less, and on day three as many as the first two days combined. How many cups total in three days?" He's sitting there fuming. I ask, "Why are you grumbling?" He goes: "They should've just eaten it all on day one instead of dragging it out for three days!"

They say if you drink 130 bottles of wine, you can save a bird's life — think of the birds. Turns out I'm not a drunk, I'm basically an ornithologist! Actually going out to "save" some birds again today.
Perks of serving guests plain green tea with no sugar or milk: you look like a refined connoisseur, you save on groceries, nobody asks for seconds — and nobody ever comes back.

A guy came up with a genius mosquito trap: he sprinkled salt instead of sugar to fool it. The mosquito lands, thinks it's sugar, but nope, it's salt. Thirsty now, it goes for a drink, but the little cap has vodka instead of water. The mosquito gets properly hammered, stumbles over a stick, and cracks its head on a rock. That's the ultimate mosquito trap.
They asked the cat to watch over the watermelons. Looks like he took the job a bit too seriously.
Stuck behind a truck in traffic and thinking: I'm about to honk at somebody up there — let them get nervous too!

A test of quick thinking. Which battle did Napoleon die in? The last one. Where was the US Declaration of Independence signed? At the bottom of the page. What's the main cause of divorce? Marriage. What will you definitely not eat for breakfast? Lunch and dinner. What looks exactly like half an apple? The other half. What happens to a red rock thrown into a blue sea? It gets wet. How do you survive 8 days without sleep? Sleep at night. If you have 3 apples and 4 oranges in one hand, and 4 apples and 3 oranges in the other, what do you have? Really big hands. How do you drop an egg on concrete without breaking it? However you want — concrete is hard to break. Finish the saying "Patience and hard work..." That's why I love my mom. Bonus point for creativity.

A row of dogs and a cat. The first dog says, "I believe in you." The second: "You've got this." The third: "You're doing great." The fourth: "Everything will be fine." The cat just glares and mutters, "Drop dead."

People raised by strict parents make perfect secret agents — they've been thinking on their feet since childhood. They can fully control their expression, gestures, heartbeat and blood pressure, so a lie detector doesn't stand a chance against them.
A son asks, "Dad, what's an alcoholic?" The father says, "See those two cars up ahead? An alcoholic would see four." There was only one car there.
Locals nicknamed the village drunk "The Hacker" after he stole the shop's debt ledger and wiped out the entire village's credit history in one go.
Judging by the look on his face, that cat clearly started the fire himself — he's just posing for the report now.

You're sitting in a fancy restaurant, fighting the urge to prop your leg up on a chair, put on YouTube, and just eat in peace like at home... Honestly, should've stayed home and had a plate of dumplings instead.
If someone calls and offers you a free relaxing trip to the countryside — don't fall for it, it's a scam: you'll show up and just end up weeding the garden!
Here's what school homework problems look like these days: "Two camels were flying, one was ginger, the other turned left. How many kilos of asphalt if the hedgehog is four years old?"
When you applied to the job as a joke, aced the interview as a joke, and now you're sitting at your new desk like you've been doing this your whole life.
My daughter drew our family for a school project — everything looks fine, except apparently we're all scuba diving.
Doc, I've got anxiety. — Let the unicorns carry your worries off into the forest — that'll be five thousand.
Yesterday my wife and I wallpapered the kitchen. I got cursed out nine times, fired back four times, and we got divorced twice. Still, we're happy with the result!
Vasya, open your eyes, or the neighbors will think you're just your ginger buddy's shadow.

A quick note on my social skills: I've been stuck inside for an hour because the neighbors are doing something in the hallway and I really don't want to walk out. Someone in the comments said the same used to happen to them — until they stopped caring, started greeting everyone, asking how they're doing, giving unsolicited advice. Now the neighbors avoid them instead.
Ladies, please keep your wigs somewhere kids can't find them! I bumped into one in the dark today, and now my hair's gone completely gray. Thanks a lot!

So I made this huge five-liter pot of borscht, and since I live alone, there's no one to eat it. There was a group of homeless guys hanging out in the yard, so I brought it out to them, spoons and all. They practically kissed my feet. Then this morning I head off to work, and there they are outside my building with a bouquet of flowers and endless thank-yous. Really sweet.
Now I've got friends among the local homeless guys.
"You know, in some African tribes men sell their wives. If we lived there, would you sell me?" "No way. I'd just give you away as a gift."

Mom comes home from work and asks what useful things the kids did today. The oldest proudly says, "I washed the dishes!" Mom praises him and hands over chocolate. The middle one: "I dried them!" He gets a cookie. The youngest quietly adds, "I swept up the pieces and took out the trash..."
Aliens showed up to conquer Earth, and ended up stuck in two weeks of quarantine instead. Honestly, I feel them.

A kid wrote a school essay titled "What My Mom Looks Like." My mom is slim. Her legs aren't very long, but she does have flat feet. Her legs are straight because she's never broken them. Her head is a bit bigger than mine, because she's very smart. She has brown eyes, thin eyebrows, and long eyelashes. Her nose is normal, but with a bump, because she fell off a bike as a kid. Her lips are two different colors because she wears lipstick. Her teeth are white and straight. She has broad shoulders, but it suits her. Dad read the essay and cried, begging him to stop.
Me two hours after leaving the hospital: "Ugh..." Me two hours after leaving the hospital, still wearing the shoe covers: "SHOE COVERS!!!"

A guy stumbles home dead drunk, his whole face smeared with lipstick, and long red hairs all over his shirt. His wife crosses her arms: "So what's the excuse this time?" Without blinking, he says: "You won't believe it — I got into a fight with a clown."

Two golden rules of business: if you're selling a service, always get paid upfront — otherwise you'll get scammed. If you're buying one, never pay upfront — otherwise you'll get scammed. That's the honest paradox of the business world.
A "house on wheels" in America is a giant luxury RV with windows and paneling. A "house on wheels" in Russia is when they just plop an ordinary village house onto a truck.

"Tell me, do you know the difference between a misfortune and a catastrophe?"
"What kind of question is that, of course I do!"
"Can you explain it, then?"
"Say your neighbor gets sick. Is that a misfortune?"
"Sure."
"But not a catastrophe, right?"
"Right, not a catastrophe."
"Now imagine some politicians flying off to a resort and the plane crashes. Is that a catastrophe?"
"Definitely."
"But is it a misfortune?"
"Not really..."

"Svetka, get up, work in 15 minutes!"
"Couldn't you wake me earlier? I need at least 20 minutes to do my makeup!"
"Relax, while you were sleeping I already did it for you..."

I walked into an appliance store, browsing around and checking prices, when I noticed a sales assistant gliding toward me with a blissful smile, clearly starving for a customer. So I beat him to it and said, "Hi there, can I help you with anything?" He froze for five seconds, then blurted out, "Yes — please, just buy something."

A psychologist lines up ten men for a test: "Anyone whose wife runs the house, take one step back." Nine men instantly step back, but one stays put. Impressed, the psychologist asks, "Tell us your secret — how do you stay the boss at home?" The guy shrugs: "No secret. My wife brought me here and told me to stand still."

A husband reads a book called "How to Be the Head of the Household" and, all fired up, tells his wife in the kitchen: "From now on, my word is law! Tonight you'll cook me a fancy dinner, run me a bath so I can relax, scrub my back, hand me my robe, give me a massage... and guess who's going to dress me and comb my hair after that?" She smirks: "No need to guess - the guy from the funeral home!"

When I was little, my dad shaved his head bald one day, and I didn't recognize him — I was terrified. That night, while my parents were asleep, I quietly called my grandma and told her some strange man was in bed with mom. Grandma showed up in like ten minutes flat. I got in so much trouble afterward.

Folk hack: toss 27 rubles in coins into a bucket of water, stir it and picture the money energy soaking in. Add a couple drops of lemon oil for extra power, and chant: "Wash, wash with lemon, I'll be a millionaire, money come on in, we'll live it up together." After a report like that, all you can say is: "Thank you, Mr. Minister of Finance."
Heartbreaking story: a Japanese guy visited Russia and ran into the very Toyota he scrapped for metal 25 years ago. And the mileage is now three times lower than back then.

"Doctor, I urgently need to be castrated!" — "Why? You're a man!" — "Not your business, here's the money, just do it." After the surgery, the doctor asks, "Come on, tell me — why such a drastic step?" — "Well, doctor, I met an Israeli girl and I want to surprise her, it's their custom." — "Then you should've asked for a circumcision!" — "Yeah, that's what I said, wasn't it?"

My wife went to stay with her parents for two weeks. When she got back, I'd taken out the trash once and washed a shot glass and the dumpling pot. Never even set foot in the other rooms — nothing to clean there. Conclusion: all the mess in this house is clearly her doing.

A cop catches a junkie at the zoo: "Are you high?" "No." "Let's find out... What's in that cage?" He points at a kangaroo. The junkie squints at it for a long time and says: "A rabbit. About forty-five years old."
My wife says I can't even boil a kettle. Pavlik, 46: "I can do literally everything!"
My wife left me a note: "When the aspic is done, drain the broth." Does anyone know what comes next?.. — Run, man... run!

I bought this thermo nail polish that turns red when it's warm and blue when it's cold. Never told my boyfriend. Every time my nails went blue he'd freak out: "They were red a second ago!" I'd just shove my hands under my sleeve and go "babe, they've always been red." The poor guy nearly lost his mind in a week.

Two drinking buddies are hanging out. One asks:
"You know why everyone calls me Genie? Probably because I can do anything."
The other replies:
"Nah. It's just that the second a bottle gets opened anywhere, you magically show up."

In the US, a woman married her ex-husband's father — she admitted she'd been in love with her father-in-law the whole time she was married to his son. Now the family's making plans: "So where are we going to live?" "At my son's place, he's alone now, split from his wife." Then the ex-husband snaps: "You ruined my whole life!" His dad cuts in: "Don't you dare yell at your mother!"

I work as a kindergarten teacher. I was tucking in a 5-year-old boy and he suddenly announced he's marrying a girl named Anna. I knew he'd always had a crush on a different girl, so I asked why. He said: "It's better to be with someone who plays the same games as me, shares her candy, and gets along with my mom, than with someone who's just pretty but would never play Bakugan with me and would eat all my candy herself." That's when I realized some kids are smarter than me.
In Canada they stick fake 3D pothole decals on the road so drivers think there's a hole and slow down. Here our potholes are real — no need to fake it, we've got genuine 3D technology.

Six years ago my husband started tiling the bathroom. Tell me, did he do everything right or skip a step somewhere? One comment says: "Nice job, totally by the book — it'll sit like that for another twenty years and nothing will happen to it"
A girl on the bus looks at a sad guy and thinks, "Something must have happened to him." He just mutters "damn it..." because his raindrop lost the race down the window again.
This is what your face looks like when you really need to sneeze and it just won't come
Guys always write "I want to lie next to you," "I want to wake up with you" — but not one has ever written "I want to do the dishes with you"... "Now where would I find a guy like that?"
Speed and technology mean nothing once you're stuck in a flock of sheep. Life works the same way.

As a kid I was forced to nap in the afternoon. I'd turn to face the wall and pretend to sleep, but really a whole carpet universe was opening up in front of me. There was an actual ritual: trace every pattern with my finger, pick at a little hole, stroke the pile. And during quiet time you could also gently press your fingers on your closed eyes — a few seconds later colorful blobs would appear, somewhere between a cartoon and a kaleidoscope.

A family is doing a crossword. Wife: "What does a man want when he looks at a woman? Four letters." Husband: "Soup!" Wife: "No, the first and last letters are the same." Husband: "Sauce!" Wife: "Ugh, when will you EVER stop thinking about food?!"
Here's how to occupy three stairs at the same time
— I've been asked to marry hundreds of times, and I always said no. — Who asked you, if you don't mind me asking? — My parents.

A buddy of mine works at a computer store. They've got a sales guy who's amazing with customers. He ends up in the hospital for surgery. Calls from his bed: "Everything's fine, just sold them ten laptops, go ahead and process the order!"

One New Year's Eve, the whole family was sitting at the table waiting for guests, TV playing in the background. Mom walks in annoyed and asks, "Who took the orange?" Right at that moment, a smooth male voice from the TV answers, "I have to confess, it was me." We still turn on that TV every year hoping he'll talk to us again.
A blue tractor rolls down the road towing a trailer — and whatever's riding in the back is never going to sing again. The driver leans out the window: "Alright buddy, go on and pick your coffin!"
How a girl laughs around her boyfriend: soft and polite. How the same girl laughs with her girlfriends: neighing like a horse. And if she snorts too, that's true friendship.
As a kid, 2044 sounded like something straight out of a sci-fi movie. Turns out it's just the year I finally pay off my mortgage.
Cats and men are alike: when they suddenly get affectionate, it's either because they want something — or because they already made a mess somewhere.

Little Johnny spent the whole day terrorizing his dad: "Dad, I know everything!" Panicking, his father whispered, "Just don't tell mom!" and slipped him 20 bucks. Then he tried the same on his mom: "Mom, I know everything!" — "Don't tell your father!" — and she handed over 50. Feeling lucky, Johnny went outside, spotted the janitor with a broom, and figured he'd try his luck one more time: eyes down, he mumbled, "Uncle Pete, I know everything..." The janitor's eyes welled up, and he opened his arms wide: "Well then, son — come give your father a hug!"
I could live like a queen on my salary — if the month only had five or six days instead of thirty.

My grandma always said nobody actually feels their age. Inside you're forever a teenager who just got saddled with adult responsibilities. Even staring at the numbers on your ID, you never feel old. I once asked her, "So how do you know you've aged?" She said: it's when you think about people your own age and go "Good lord, look what happened to him, all wrinkled up." Because odds are, you look exactly the same.
Rare footage: this is exactly how truck drivers are born.
Mom says: "This animal only eats, sleeps, and poops." My dog and I just stare at each other, trying to figure out which one of us she's talking about
When your cat begs you to open the door, then just stands there not leaving — it's not that he changed his mind. He's waiting for you to go outside instead.

"They say when a woman starts a fight, a historian wakes up inside her."
"You mean a hysteric?"
"No, a historian. She'll list every mistake you ever made, with the exact date and time."
Phone rings: "We have your kid." "What are your demands?" "You idiot, hurry up, daycare's about to close!"

I'd been staying at the cabin a week when a fat dog in a collar showed up at the gate — clearly somebody's pet. I let him in. He found a corner, curled up, napped for an hour, then left. Next day he came back for another nap in the same spot. So I tucked a note under his collar: "Does this dog have an owner, and does he know she comes to my place every day to sleep?" The next day the dog showed up with a reply: "I'm the owner. We've got six kids at home, two under three. She comes to your place to actually get some rest. Mind if I join her?"

Lost my job, so out of spite I wrote my resume like: "I'm a gloomy lazy jerk who wants to work less and earn more, and I couldn't care less what you think of me" — then blasted it out everywhere. Yesterday one company actually called back and invited me for an interview. Now I'm sitting here shaking because I have no idea what they even want from me.
"Nah, night shifts aren't that bad, honestly. You just get used to it eventually." Alexander, 22 — already sounding like a guy who's been doing this for thirty years.
As a kid I was terrified of ghosts. My mom secretly told me you could just suck them up with a vacuum cleaner. So I became a real "ghostbuster" — and she just enjoyed having a spotless apartment.

A biology teacher told a story about her friend who teaches English. Before assigning homework, she always makes a show of complaining: "Can you believe this program? Translate three texts, learn forty words, do three exercises — that's insane!" Then she "takes pity" on the class: "Fine, just translate two texts, learn twenty words, do two exercises." The kids are thrilled and love her for it. Secretly, she's laughing to herself — she was planning to assign even less anyway.

An old lady goes to the doctor and complains, "Doctor, my leg hurts so badly!" The doctor shrugs, "Well, what do you expect, it's eighty years old." The old lady replies, "My other leg is eighty too, and it doesn't hurt at all!"

"Grandma, have you seen my power bank?"
"It's somewhere up in the attic shelf."
"What's an attic shelf?"
"What's a power bank?"
Dad's in for a surprise: the boys decided to fill up the car themselves — with the garden hose. Full tank, zero cost!
I stopped by my daughter's place. Her husband said he'd left the keys under the doormat... turns out "under the doormat" meant three Dobermans.

A man walks up to the reception desk at a clinic:
"Miss, I need to see the doctor!"
"Sure, I'll put you on the list — come back in a week when it's your turn."
"And what if I die before then?"
"No problem, just have your wife call us and we'll cross you off the list."
Nothing wakes you up in the morning like discovering someone heated an electric kettle on the stove.

Very true to life.

Wolves cornered a dog and were about to eat it. The dog begged for its life, promising to help round up sheep and pull its weight. The wolves thought it over and let it join the pack. For two years it worked hard — teaching them to hunt, scouting good spots, going out on jobs right alongside them.

Then came an especially rough, hungry winter. The hunts kept failing, the wolves got desperate, and they decided to eat the dog after all. So they did. They buried the bones and put up a little headstone, then argued about what to write on it. "From friends"? Doesn't quite work — some friends, eating you. "From enemies"? Also wrong — two years side by side, no hard feelings.

After some thought, they settled on: "From your colleagues."

My friend was terrified she was pregnant but too embarrassed to buy the tests herself, so I went and got her four. All four came back positive. I kept wondering how she'd managed to be THAT thorough. She just sobbed on my shoulder and asked, "How am I supposed to raise four kids at once?" After that I stopped asking questions — honestly, of course it was her who got knocked up.

When my girlfriend and I started dating, she gave me a cool t-shirt with the number 24 on it. A few months later we broke up. Recently I saw her with a new guy — wearing the exact same shirt, but with the number 25. Come on, Anastasia, seriously?
A guy is climbing what feels like a thousand steps up a mountain, and from the top his wife yells down: "Did you get the bread??" He just groans: "Oh, come ON...!!!"

In China, a guy kicked a stray dog that was just napping on his parking spot. The dog took it personally — came back with a whole squad of friends, and they gave his car a proper chewing and scratching.

The doctor finishes checking the old lady: "Well, everything's fine, you're perfectly healthy. Now remind me, what exactly were you complaining about?" "I get out of breath, doctor." "When does that happen?" "Whenever I have to run for the bus and can't catch it!"
