- Valya, why are you screaming?! - There's a spider! - So what? - It's hideous! - Like you're some beauty queen yourself. At least it's not screaming...

My husband, our daughter and I were driving home from my parents' when some guy cut us off. My husband lost it and yelled, "What's your problem, jerk?!" I hushed him for cursing in front of our kid — and right then our three-year-old stuck her little fist out the window and yelled with just as much passion, "Watch where you're going, donkey?!" My husband was grinning all evening, bought her a new doll, and announced a daughter is even cooler than a son. I will never understand men…

I'm having coffee, watching the news. First some scammers convince people everything's been stolen from them and talk them out of their money "for help." Then it turns out local officials were bribed too. And by the end, some lonely guy gets sweet-talked out of his only home, while the whole gang throws a party right there in his living room. Basically, Puss in Boots isn't a fairy tale, it's a training manual for con artists.
My husband brought home a new fridge magnet — I nearly had a heart attack, I thought it was the cat stuck to it!

This is how I picture most diets: day one — six boiled eggs, day two — a pound of low-fat cottage cheese, day three — a pound and a half of chicken breast, day four — a cup of rice, day five — six potatoes, day six — apples, and on day seven you wake up at a kebab stand clutching a bag of meat pies, screaming about the apocalypse, and grabbing meat straight off the spit. But if you swap "day" for "lunch," it's actually a pretty normal diet.
Just born, and already nothing pleases him.

One winter evening I decided to fry some potatoes in the dorm, but I was out of onions. So I went to borrow one from my neighbor — who happened to be hiding a bag of meat outside his window, hanging it on a hook to keep it cold. My knock startled him and the bag fell outside.
"Run!" he screamed, bolting past me. I chased after him without even knowing why. We rounded the building and found a pack of dogs surrounding the meat bag sticking out of a snowdrift, growling viciously.
Then my neighbor let out a roar that would've made Tarzan jealous, charged straight into the pack, wrestled one dog off, and reclaimed his meat. The dogs scattered with their tails between their legs, and the winner marched back into the dorm carrying his prize like a trophy.
I never did get my onion, and my potatoes burned to a crisp. But I finally understood why humans are at the top of the food chain.
Great. Now I'm going to spend the rest of my life figuring out which one of them was in every movie I've seen with this face — Mark Strong or Stanley Tucci.
List of countries I'll be vacationing in this summer: Worklandia, the Couch Islands, and the United Garden Emirates.

- Dima, I can't do this anymore, we need to break up. You're always correcting me.
- My name's Oleg!
- See? No matter what I say, it's never right!
She had the nerve to cook dinner in the very pot she used to hit me with.
Optical illusion: this photo shows three donkeys — but flip it upside down, and somehow there are four.
Guys talking to girls in movies: smooth lines by the lockers. Guys talking to girls in real life: "Are your parents, by any chance... parents?"
Yesterday I skipped work and lied that I was sick. Today three coworkers didn't show up either — they said they caught it from me. The whole office is full of slackers.
The waiter asks: "Would you like cold rice porridge with cucumber?" "No." "How about with raw fish?" "No!" "Maybe with mayo?" "Definitely not!" "So... how about sushi?" "Oh, sushi — I love that!"

My cat watches TV with me, and he has an opinion about everything. Some trashy reality show comes on — he shakes his head in disgust. A horror movie starts — he jumps in my lap and flinches at the scary parts. During a comedy, he sits next to me, and I swear I can hear him laughing. And during the commercials, he runs to the litter box and comes back with a snack. I'm pretty sure this little guy is about to evolve.

On a bus, a guy keeps needling a woman with word games. "Miss, are you getting off?" "People get off drugs!" "Are you leaving, then?" "People leave their senses!" "Well, are you climbing out?" "People climb out at birth!" So the guy just shoves her off the bus, yelling: "Happy birthday!"

When our son turned four, he got scared of monsters. So we told him monsters are terrified of kids' laughter. For the next week we had to get used to him cackling at night in the bathroom and on the way there and back, obviously. Now my mother-in-law refuses to visit. She says we need to call a priest, because the kid runs around the apartment at night laughing like he crawled straight out of hell.

Oh my, I really lucked out with my husband! His friends decided to prank him — called and said I'd fallen into a pool full of crocodiles. He calmly replied, "Those are your crocodiles, you go rescue them!"
This is how life works: some people have tons of connections and contacts, and then there's me, barely squeezing through a tiny gap.
A boy tells his mom, "My stomach hurts." She says, "Maybe it's just empty." He fires back, "So that explains why your head always hurts!"

My friend called me in a panic that morning — she'd found some kind of lump on her cat's belly and wanted me to come with her to the vet. We got there, the vet starts feeling the cat's stomach. My friend whispers, terrified: "Doctor, what is it?" The vet whispers back, dead serious: "It's just fat." We nearly fell out of our chairs.
I spend every day on hair and skincare routines, but my husband only recognizes cream when it's on a cake.

My mother-in-law and I get along great — we hang out and go to the movies all the time. The other day we were stuck in traffic on the way to the country house, and some guy tried to hit on me. I brushed him off, obviously. And she goes, "Why'd you do that? He seemed nice and clearly had money, you should've gone for it." I just stare at her, and she suddenly smacks her forehead: "Oh right, I forgot who I was talking to."
Looks like someone decided he could install the AC unit himself. And here I was wondering why our courtyard is colder than the whole city!

My husband texted: "What coffee should I get?" I got carried away: "I want something strong but smooth, wild yet tender, that flips my whole soul upside down and opens a world of temptation and new sensations!" After a long wait, his reply came: "Got it. Buying vodka."

Grandma's writing her will: "10 kilos of buckwheat go to my friend Petrovna. A stash of sugar goes to my neighbor Vitya — he's a moonshiner and he hung my curtain rod. And 50 rolls of toilet paper go to my grandson Slavik... the little pooper."
Judging by the tracks in the snow, this pigeon just got a call from grandma checking in — and catching up on every relative from the last twenty years.
"Gal, how was your date?" "I had to slap him five times!" "Was he getting handsy?" "No, he kept falling asleep!"
Ever notice how with all these trendy words like "abuser," "toxic," and "hater," we've almost forgotten the good old term "a lost cause"? Back in the day everyone understood it perfectly anyway.

Rush hour, the bus is packed. A mom peels an orange, hands the slices to her five-year-old, and tosses the peel out the cracked window. Passengers start grumbling, and the little girl chimes in too: "Mom, how could you!" Everyone melts — what a well-raised kid! Then she finishes the sentence: "Those peels are supposed to go in the moonshine!"
A cop pulls the car over: "Your papers, please!" The cat in the back seat: "Told not to hand them over." "Who told you?" "Told not to say."
Our sergeant always used to say: "You keep digging here, and I'll go find out where we're actually supposed to dig."
The boss during the interview: "We've got a super friendly team here, real sweethearts!" Meanwhile the actual team looks like this... (Guessing that's the accounting department in the photo?)
Calling tech support: "Is this support?" "Yes, what's wrong?" "I don't want to go to work tomorrow." "We fully support that!"
This is basically what a blanket looks like at 3am when you're trying to find its long edge.
Hired a photographer for the backyard barbecue — the shot came out perfect: everyone's facing away, not a single face in sight!
I just found out how babies get X-rayed and now I can't unsee it — it looks exactly like a blender.

I got invited to a birthday party at a pizza place. Table looked amazing, but the menu had zero alcohol. My buddy handed me some cash and asked me to run to the store, grab some cognac, pour it into an empty iced-tea bottle so the staff wouldn't hassle us about outside booze, and bring it back. So I bought the cognac and a bottle of iced tea, stepped outside, sat on a bench and started pouring. A woman walks by, smiles, and asks: "Heading to the parent-teacher meeting too?"

I sometimes get nosebleeds, and I can usually feel one coming about thirty seconds before it starts. Today in class it happened again, so right before it hit I turned to this really religious kid next to me and whispered, "Hail Satan." Right on cue, my nose started bleeding. He freaked out so hard he fell off his chair and hit his head, and skipped the rest of his classes that day.

This morning a call from the bank woke me up: "Come pick up your prize, you did enter our contest, right?" I'm like... huh? They said my drawing won the audience-choice award in a kids' drawing contest. Then I remembered — waiting in line out of boredom, I'd doodled a fat cat with glassy eyes and signed it "Sergey, age 28." Guess I've got to go pick it up now.
Wife: "Make sure the cat doesn't steal food off the table." Husband: "No problem" — and he locked the cat safely under a mesh cover, right on the table.

One winter our cat brought home a scrawny neighborhood cat named Tikhon who could barely stand on his legs. We fed him up and he stayed with us alongside our cat Barsik. Even though both were grown, unneutered males, they never fought once and always shared their food. Turns out Tikhon had his own soft side too: he'd steal freshly caught fish from his owner and carry it over to a neighbor's cat named Fimka, whose owners barely fed him. Tikhon was a total brawler — fought dogs, disappeared on week-long benders — but he had a heart of gold. Someone in the comments summed it up: this cat was so responsible he went and got himself his own cat. Respect.
At some point you'll realize just how tiny all your years of accumulated knowledge and experience really are — the moment a six-year-old asks you, "Why does the bag rustle?"
Let me tell you a secret about men: there are only two kinds — ordinary jerks and extraordinary jerks.
The driving instructor tells his student, "Here at the roundabout, just go straight." She takes it literally — and drives right over the grass island in the middle.
This ambulance looks like the wolves from "Masha and the Bear" had to give it back!
I was walking with my girlfriend when some guy whistled at her and yelled, "nice ass!" She got really annoyed and wanted me to say something back. So I turned around and said, "Thanks, I do squats."

My husband's sweatpants finally gave out — the ones he's known longer than he's known me. Now we have to find new ones, and honestly the thought terrifies me: hundreds of pairs that won't fit, daydreams of moving to India just to never wear pants again, requests to mend pants that have basically turned into mold and dust. A real ordeal, finding THE pair. And in the end he'll just snap, grab the first ones he sees, and somehow those become the worthy replacement.
A man from Africa posted a selfie captioned, "First time ever riding a bus driven by a woman." Ten minutes later he posted another photo — standing next to the bus, now flipped over in a ditch.
Rex, you menace, spit out that pine cone right now! You nearly scared me gray!
A guy bought a watermelon through the train window — guess he figured it'll last him the rest of the trip
The teacher says, "Timmy, your essay about the cat is word-for-word identical to your brother's." Timmy shrugs: "Well, we've only got one cat."
"Let's meet tonight?" "Sure, how will I recognize you?" "I'll be wearing stilettos and awesome pants…"
"Girls, I'm on a flight to Turkey!" — meanwhile she's just leaning off her balcony taking a selfie against the skyline, pretending it's a plane window. That's how a lot of people "fly" these days.
My brother and I in public: we'd do anything for each other, we're family after all. My brother and I at home: "Cut it straight already, for heaven's sake!"

The director is staring intently at the new secretary.
"She has four kids," the HR manager whispers in his ear.
"No way! She's so young and already has four kids?!"
"No, YOU have four kids..."
First dad swears the cat will move in over his dead body. A month later the two of them are fixing the kitchen faucet together.

My husband claims he doesn't like cats at all. One evening on our walk, a scrappy little black kitten followed us home and plopped down right at our gate like it was saying goodbye. He grumbled that I'd have to take care of it myself, but we brought it inside anyway. I got it settled and it fell asleep. Later I couldn't find my husband — I walk out and hear him whispering to the kitten: "Eat this sausage, grow into the biggest cat ever, and go poop right at the neighbors' door — I'm sick of their dog."

My dad told this one: back in trade school, he had to submit a drawing for his final project. So he asked a buddy to find someone who'd do it for cash. On defense day, dad hangs up his drawing — and the professor's face just freezes, smile stuck in place. After the presentation, the professor says, "Well, it'd be a sin not to give myself an A."

A woman is walking past a cemetery at night, terrified. Suddenly a man appears and offers to walk her home. As they go, he keeps cracking jokes the whole way. She laughs and says, "Wow, you're such a fun guy!" He replies, "You should've seen me when I was alive..."
The doctor says: you're really stressed, take this medicine three times a day. The patient asks: which medicine? The doctor looks confused: what does medicine have to do with anything?

The doctor examines the old lady and says, "Everything checks out, you're perfectly healthy. So what exactly were you complaining about?" "I get out of breath, doctor." "And when does that happen?" "Whenever I run after the bus and can't catch it!"

It's late at night. Grandpa is helping his second-grade grandson with Russian homework. Both are exhausted, and the kid can barely think straight anymore.
Grandpa, annoyed:
"Come on, think! There are two crows sitting on a fence, and a third one flies over. What question should you ask?"
The grandson stays silent, straining to focus, but his tired brain just won't cooperate.
"It's so simple! Two crows on a fence, a third one joins them — what's the question?"
Finally, the grandson timidly offers his own answer:
"Um... hi, mind if I sit with you?"
Me: *jumps out of bed too fast*. My head, instantly: "Congrats, you've lost your hearing, vision, and balance!" That's basically my brain 24/7.

Changing the bed sheets. I open the linen drawer — pull out a cat. Pull out a pillow — pull out a cat. Get distracted for a second — pull out a cat. Pull out a blanket — another cat. Pull out a sheet — yet another cat. I look in the drawer — no more cat. But a sheet just sprinted past me at full speed...
Saw a girl on the subway today. Something about her felt so warm and familiar... Then it hit me — her jacket has the exact pattern of grandma's old plaid blanket!

My husband threw his new t-shirt with our daughter's photo on it into the wash. I opened the drum and her face was staring right at me — nearly gave me a heart attack! "She's smiling though, what's the problem?"
A boy tearfully tells his dad, "Dad, I think you love beer more than us." The father calmly pats his head: "Don't be silly, Brewski."

Prison. They bring a little old man into the cell. The inmates crowd around him:
"So, gramps, what are you in for?"
"For jokes. I love a good prank."
"Go on then, prank us."
"Nah, you'll beat me up after."
The head inmate says:
"I swear, nobody will touch you."
"Alright then."
The old man grabs a broom, dips it in the toilet bucket, and knocks on the door hatch with it. A guard peeks in — the old man instantly wipes the broom right across his face. The hatch slams shut.
The whole cell is dying laughing. A minute later the door bursts open — a whole squad of huge guards with batons standing there.
They scan the room:
"Alright, gramps, step aside — we're about to prank these jokers ourselves..."

Dad asks Johnny:
"Why did you tell everyone the math teacher was kissing the gym teacher?"
"She asked me to!"
"What do you mean, she asked you?"
"She said: 'Johnny, why do you keep giggling in the back row? Tell everyone, we'll all laugh together!'"

When I was five, I was terrified of dentists. My dad took me in because a baby tooth was barely hanging on. We walk into the room and the dentist sweetly asks, "Show me which tooth is loose." So I just yanked it out myself and handed it to him with a completely straight face.

A vet is training a new assistant to give a horse a laxative pill: you put one pill in your own mouth, one in the horse's, connect the two with a hollow tube, and blow from your end. The trainee nods — got it. Next day he shows up two hours late, pale green. "What happened?" asks the vet. "The horse blew first!"

I was on the bus and noticed a guy holding a ginger kitten, kissing it on the forehead nonstop. It was so sweet... but my eyesight is bad, so I put on my glasses — and realized it wasn't a kitten at all, just a fried meat pie.
Took me a solid three minutes to realize the person sitting in that chair is actually a dude.
Life hack: tired at work? Grab a ladder, lie down next to it, and pretend you fell off and passed out — nobody will question it

Our son is two and can barely say a few mangled words in Russian, but on his own made-up language he never shuts up — and always with dramatic intonation, like he's giving a speech. My husband and I used to joke that he's clearly been talking for ages, just not in Russian. Then the other day he swiped my phone, turned on voice search, and started whispering into it. I grabbed it back and saw a page open in some foreign language. Finally, I thought, we'll find out what he's been saying. I copied the phrase into a translator... turns out our toddler is fluent in Slovenian. And the translated search was: "How do I leave this country?"
"My husband finally quit drinking!" "No way, how?" "Our pet squirrel grabbed dishes from the dollhouse this morning, and the first thing he saw when he opened his eyes was this."
"Sir, your cat in that backpack looks like it melted..." "And here I was searching for the animal in the white sand!"
Whenever coworkers ask "Where are you going on vacation?", I start suspecting their salary is bigger than mine. Makes you wonder: are we actually paid the same?

I'm walking home and overhear a seven-year-old boy begging his mom in tears: "Please buy it!" Mom says, "I already told you it's fine, but who's going to take care of it in the apartment?" The boy jumps in: "I will!" I get all sentimental remembering how I begged for a dog as a kid too. Then the mom adds: "And exactly how are you planning to take care of a live cow in an apartment?!"
This is exactly how the daughter-in-law looks through the mother-in-law's eyes when her precious son is standing next to her
She's thinking: if I ignore him all day, he'll figure out I'm mad at him. Meanwhile he's driving his tractor through the field thinking: what a wonderfully peaceful day.

Tutoring a seventh-grader. He reads the problem and says, "I have no idea what this is asking, but I'm just gonna do something anyway." Kid, you have no idea how useful that attitude will be at your future job.

Whenever I start feeling dumb, I remember my coworker's first solo gas station trip. When the cashier asked, "How much fuel?" she said, "I don't know... enough for a week?" Instantly feel better about myself.
My husband got us a cat. I lay down for a nap, woke up, turned my head — and nearly died of fright: this bat-eared monster was sitting right next to me, silently staring into my soul.
When someone in the comments says cats should live outside and hunt mice for food
I inherited this toaster from the 1920s about ten years ago — and it still toasts bread like a champ!

It was grandma's birthday, and while my wife was congratulating her mom on the phone, my son and his friend were doing homework in the next room. I asked my son, "Don't you want to wish Grandma happy birthday?" He said, "Nah, if I do, she'll spend half an hour showering me with wishes like it's MY birthday." Then his friend chimes in, "I always recite a poem about grandmas to mine — they burst into tears and hang up instantly."
At first dad swears the cat moves in only over his dead body. A month later, the two of them are fixing the kitchen faucet together.

— Babe, you won't believe it, I just walked past some kids summoning a demon. So creepy.
— Doesn't it bother you that right at that moment, you showed up?

My 16-year-old son has had a girlfriend for six months now, and they hang out almost every day. Today she left for ten days for a competition, and he walked her to the station. He comes home beaming: "Finally, ten days of freedom!" I'm stunned: "Wait, you're happy about this? I thought you'd be sad." He gets all sheepish: "I mean, sure, I'm sad... but now I get to hang out with the guys more and play more games!" And that's when it hit me — that's exactly how a husband acts when his wife takes the kids on a ten-day vacation.

Advice from a 105-year-old grandma: beer for digestion, wine for appetite, cognac for low blood pressure, whiskey for high, and a shot of vodka when it's cold. "And water?" "I've never felt so awful!"

— Remember this morning when I ran around the apartment shouting happily, "Finally found those damn keys!"? — Yeah, I remember. — Well, you didn't happen to notice where I put them after that, did you?
Nothing wakes you up in the morning like an electric kettle someone accidentally left on the hot stove

A guy goes to a lawyer for advice. He says his neighbor borrowed five hundred bucks and won't pay it back — can he sue? The lawyer asks if he has any written proof of the debt. Nope, he says, it was just a verbal agreement. So the lawyer tells him: write your neighbor a letter demanding he immediately repay one thousand dollars. The guy's confused — but he only owes me five hundred! Exactly, says the lawyer. That's precisely what he'll write back to correct you. And that'll be your written proof.
The wife lies there thinking, "He's daydreaming about other women again..." Meanwhile her husband is quietly mumbling a kids' lullaby, tucking in a little bull, a bear, and an elephant one by one.
Waiter, where's the chicken in this broth? Did it drown? — No, it just took a bath and left.
At a job interview: "You must love drawing, right?" "Yeah, how did you guess?" "By your eyebrows."

An old man married a young woman. A year later he brings her to the maternity ward. "Congratulations!" says the doctor. "The secret's simple," the old man beams, "you've got to keep the engine running!" A year passes, and there he is again with his wife in labor. "Wow, grandpa, you've still got it!" the doctor marvels. "Gotta keep that engine in working order," he repeats proudly. Another year goes by and it happens again — but this time the doctor pulls him aside and whispers, "Grandpa, it might be time to change the oil... the baby was born black."

A woman is on a bus and needs to pass money to the driver through another passenger, but doesn't know her name. She starts reasoning: "This is the express route, so she didn't get off at the last stop — she must be heading to my neighborhood. She's got an expensive bottle of wine, so she's visiting a good-looking guy. There are only two good-looking guys around here: my husband and my lover. She can't be going to my lover's, because that's where I'm headed. So she must be going to my husband's. He's got two mistresses, Kate and Julia. Kate's in Miami right now..." She turns and says: "Julia, could you pass this up for the fare?" The other woman freezes: "How do you know my name?!"
A girl can't wait to land in Paris, so she posts a glamorous photo on the airplane stairs. Here's what it actually looked like. That guy by the window was probably on the same flight.
A dentist tries to calm his patient: "Sasha, don't worry, everyone's nervous their first time." She replies, "I'm not Sasha, though." He looks at her and says, "Sasha's me."

A businessman, a president, and a teacher end up in hell. The president asks the devil for permission to call and check on his country. The devil agrees. After a 5-minute call, he asks the price — the devil says "$5,000!" He pays.
The businessman wants to call too, to check on his business. He wraps it up in 2 minutes and asks the price — the devil says "$5,000,000!" He pays.
The teacher asks to call the school. She talks for 8 hours straight about lessons, students, grades, staff meetings, reports, events, diaries, class registers, evaluations, tests, and portfolios. When she's done, she asks the price. The devil says: "Free!"
The president and the businessman are stunned: "Why?!" The devil replies: "Hell to hell — in-network calls are free!"
At dinner, the husband asks his wife: "Fancy a shot?" She replies: "Do what you want, but I'm definitely having one."

The teacher tells the class, "Everyone who thinks they're a fool, stand up." After a long silence, little Johnny stands up. The teacher asks, "Do you really think you're a fool?" He says, "Not really, I just felt bad you were standing there alone."
Why bother washing the baby? Just let the cat lick it clean!
Snow was sent to us from above! Who are we to shovel it?
When a woman is determined to look gorgeous, nothing can stop her — she'll make do with whatever tool is at hand!
If someone tells you "love doesn't exist," don't believe them. That person definitely had it once, real and powerful. Someone just hurt them very badly afterward.
This is how I imagine I look doing a plank. And here's how it actually looks from the outside — basically an elephant with its face buried in the surf.

Classic women's magazine: page 20 says love yourself as you are, page 23 says lose five pounds by summer, and page 28 hands you a chocolate cake recipe. Result: she lost the weight, gained it right back on the cake, ended up exactly where she started, and finally loved herself just the way she was.

A for-sale sign scrawled on the car's back window read: "Buy me! My owner found someone else, but I was always faithful and never let him down. I can't bear watching this betrayal... here's his phone number."
My wife once said I couldn't even boil a kettle. So I proved her wrong — now the kettle's boiling right inside the pot!
I tell myself: that's it, no more spending money on useless stuff. Then payday hits and I'm like: buying my cat a full suit of armor.
Ask a girl for a tissue, headphones, a screwdriver, dumbbells, a spare tire — literally anything — and she'll dive into her bag with total confidence: "It's in here somewhere, I know it..."
I ask: "Honey, I'm ready, are you almost done?" And she's the one who was rushing me a minute ago.

Fun fact: every fall, a chipmunk's brain grows bigger just so it can remember where it stashed all its food. But getting smarter also means suddenly grasping the full weight of existence. The only cure is bingeing on fermented fruit until the brain shrinks back to a comfortable size. Chipmunk: "I just don't know how to live this life anymore."

A famous Senegalese footballer, a Liverpool star, still walks around with an old phone with a cracked screen. He could afford a new smartphone every day, but instead of yachts or sports cars, he builds schools and stadiums back home and sends $70 a month to struggling families in the poor neighborhood where he grew up.
You don't even need to guess which country this is — it's obvious at first glance.
Heads up, guys — there's a traffic cop up ahead!
The cat whispers to the baby: "Stay quiet for now — at three in the morning, we start the concert together."
Teacher: "Why weren't you in class?" Student: "I've got a Nokia 3310, I couldn't scan the QR code with the schedule."
The doctor examines the patient: "That's a nasty cough — do you smoke?" "I do." "Drink too?" "Sometimes." "Then you must quit both immediately!" "So what, I'm just supposed to cough in silence now?!"

I still remember my kindergarten teacher, even though I'm over 30 now. She was young, pretty, and so kind, and for some reason she was especially warm with me — probably sensed things weren't great at home. She used to call me "kitten." The other day I'm standing at the bus stop and there's a woman next to me who looks exactly like her, just older. Memories come flooding back, I'm staring and grinning like an idiot. She notices me staring and looks back for a long moment. I'm thinking, great, she's going to think I'm a weirdo. Then she says: "Kitten, is that you?!"
Selling a hunting dog. Reason for sale: still hasn't figured out the point of hunting.

Now it all makes sense: this isn't a trendy studio apartment in downtown Moscow, it's a prison cell in Switzerland. And the bars on the windows aren't really to keep anyone in — nobody wants to escape from here, they're more to stop people trying to break in.

My wife calls me: the cat sat on the laptop keyboard and the screen went dark. I figured she'd hit some display-switch shortcut, started explaining which keys to look for, then gave up and said I'd check it that evening. Ten minutes later she calls back: "You always help everyone else, but you can't help me. Fine, I fixed it myself, no thanks to you." I ask how. "I put the cat back on the keyboard. Works now."

Dream #347: I want a tour package for chronically sleep-deprived people. You arrive at a quiet cottage by the sea, sink into a giant comfy bed, and the staff's whole job is to NOT wake you up. You just sleep for days to the sound of the waves, wake up to find fruit and tea already on the table, take a walk on the beach, and go right back to sleep.

Gennady went mushroom picking in the woods. Walking along, he spots a tiny freezing frog, and suddenly it speaks in a human voice: "Kind sir, take me with you." Gennady felt sorry for it, tucked it in his coat, warmed it up at home, fed it. Then the frog asked him to put it in bed and kiss it. The moment he did, it turned into a gorgeous, curvy blonde. Right then his wife Antonina walked in from work — and didn't believe a word of it.
Asked my wife to warm up the car while I got ready. Came out and she'd just wrapped it in a blanket like a shivering kitten and gone back inside for tea.

"Babe, send me a pic of you..."
"Sure thing!"
"Gorgeous! So which one are you, left or right?"
"Neither, I'm the one eating chips..."
Me after I just wanted to make myself one sandwich.
My neighbor is ninety years old. I bring her bread, milk, and every now and then something a bit stronger. And she tells me, dead serious: watch it, if you die I'll be all alone here!
Laziness... then a sudden burst of motivation... then laziness again.

"Your husband needs total rest. Here's a sedative."
"And when should I give it to him?"
"You misunderstood. It's not for him. It's for you."

Job interview:
"The salary starts at 15k, then jumps to 50k after a while."
"Great, I'll start in a while then."
Today I wanted something tasty, and I realized with horror that the only thing that truly satisfies that craving now is cottage cheese. So this is what getting old feels like.

I'm drinking coffee, watching TV, and there's this whole scam playing out: first they convince people everything's been stolen from them to squeeze out cash, then bribe officials for kickbacks, and by the end some poor lonely guy gets sweet-talked out of his only home while the whole gang parties inside it. That's when it hits you — "Puss in Boots" isn't a kids' cartoon, it's basically a con artist's training manual.
A girl's kitchen life hack: to relieve stress, she grabs a chicken, names it Andrew, cuts off whatever she feels like, and slowly lowers it into boiling water.

Funny how after turning 30 you suddenly have to learn skills like "go to bed on time," "exercise once a week," "actually relax," "do nothing on weekends," and "stop feeling guilty about your pointless existence." And after 40 you start truly appreciating the joys of your annual checkup.

My husband and I spent half an hour searching the whole yard for our kid, we nearly went gray with worry! Finally we checked under the stroller — turns out he'd been napping peacefully in the basket the whole time.

An old lady goes to see the gynecologist. The doctor examines her, finds nothing wrong, and says, "Ma'am, your health is perfectly fine. So what's actually bothering you?" "My tooth, dear, my tooth!" "Your tooth?! Why didn't you say so right away? You saw where I was examining!" "How would I know where you were looking? Maybe you were checking the root..."

My husband and I don't have kids yet, so our cat gets all the parental love — we genuinely call her "the baby." We were at the checkout when I remembered we forgot her food. I told him, "Ugh, the baby hasn't eaten! Go grab some, just make sure it says 'under one year' and 'veal.'" The whole line got misty-eyed watching the "young parents" — right up until he came back with two cans of cat food.
She's sure he's thinking about other women again... Really, he's just realizing that to English speakers, crows must sound like they're flying around yelling 'Car! Car! Car!' nonstop.
"Grandma, I'm really not hungry!" "Fine, I'll just warm up one little meatball for you."
This path is perfect for my daily morning jogs.
Electricians have a simple approach: why cut down the tree when the wires already run right through it?

I spent the night at my girlfriend's place. I woke up at 2am because she was smacking me. "What was that for?!" She said she got cold and wanted me to warm her up. Still half-asleep, I mumbled, "There's a campfire for that." She's still mad at me.
When you're washing windows from outside on the tenth floor, the main thing is not to forget to put your apartment keys in your pocket.
Wife to husband: "Honey, I want some romance! Ask me out on a date!" "Fine! Meet me in the kitchen at 8pm." "And what happens there?" "We'll have tea."
Every evening she'd sit on the balcony and think about him.
Getting ready for summer: do 30 push-ups before every meal. The effect is amazing — your hands shake so much you can barely get food to your mouth! A guaranteed way to lose weight, highly recommend.
Drawing my dog for the very first time, go easy on me... Comment below: "Whoa, it looks exactly like a real dog!"

My dad's name was Henry, and he drove a taxi for years. Every driver had a number for the dispatcher, and his was fourteen. Sometimes my brother filled in for him. Once the dispatcher didn't recognize the voice, so he said, "This is the son of Henry the Fourteenth." Ever since, people jokingly called them the royal family.

A girl brought her boyfriend home to meet her parents. Her dad asks, "Dmitry, what'll you have to drink?" He replies, "Oh, I don't drink." Dad pauses. "Hmm... life with our Lena is gonna be rough for you."

Here's how I learned to mind my own business. I was walking past a mental hospital and heard everyone chanting: "Thirteen! Thirteen! Thirteen!" Curious, I found a gap in the tall fence and leaned in for a look — and someone jabbed me right in the eye with a stick! Then they all cheered: "Fourteen! Fourteen! Fourteen!"

After 40, your body feels like the check-engine light has been on forever and the oil change is way overdue, but you just keep driving anyway. The suspension creaks, the exhaust reeks, and you're scared to take it in for service because it'll cost a fortune. Plus it feels like the fuel gauge is basically on empty, with no more gas stations in sight...

These days parents spend a whole month planning a kid's birthday - picking entertainers, characters, the perfect venue - terrified the child might get bored. For my tenth birthday, my parents just dropped me off in a potato field. "Mom, you said we were having a barbecue!" "Barbecue? First we finish the potatoes, grab some corn, pick some apples - then home, to work!"
Looking at that scooter parked above the doorway, I've only got two questions for the owner: how did it get up there, and why?

Our professor loves telling this story about a friend of his who just walked away from everything — family, job, friends — bought a flute, and moved to Tibet to knit alpaca wool scarves. Honestly, I feel like I'm not far behind him: at this point only a flute and a herd of alpacas can save my mental health.
Don't feel like buckling up in winter? Easy fix: just wear a t-shirt with a fake seatbelt printed on it — through a frosted windshield, nobody can tell the difference! Genius!!!
My relationship status: lying around waiting for hot guys to start falling from the sky. "Could you hurry up, I'm not getting any younger here."
Me: carefully nudging the shower knob to make the water just a tiny bit cooler. Shower: welcome to the Himalayas!
Fun fact: baby seals are actually called pups. So somewhere out there, a puppy is swimming around in the ocean, and it seems pretty chill about it.

Women pick a special shampoo just for dry, damaged hair. Guys grab one "6-in-1" bottle that also handles the body, face, carpets, the car, and the dishes. The result is predictable: she ends up looking like a scruffy stray dog, and he walks around with a majestic lion's mane.
Funny thing about this photo of a crow — it's actually a cat.
My husband decided to put the borscht pot in the fridge. Genius plan — except the pot barely fit under the shelf, and now the fridge door won't close.
Everyone kept bugging me: "describe yourself, describe yourself" for my profile. Fine, so I wrote: "Otherworldly, fairy-tale beauty!"
My wife asked me to take a photo of her with the dog. She hasn't spoken to me in a week.
Before picking a hobby, think about what your cat would say about it: "You really should've just taken up fishing, Oleg."

One evening the whole family is sitting on the couch watching TV. The parents' cat — a hefty British Shorthair, easily 15 pounds — is sprawled out in the armchair. A few minutes later, an annoyed meow comes from the chair. Dad instantly jumps up, rushes over, and gently rolls the cat onto its other side. The cat yawns and goes right back to sleep. Seeing our confused faces, Dad explained: "He was lying uncomfortably."
"Honey, remember when you went fishing?" "Yeah, why?" "Your pike just called — said she's expecting!"
Oh, so true! Try to spot the only passenger in this photo who's actually having a great day!

A wife texts her husband: "Won't make it to the store after work, grab a chicken for dinner." A bit later she gets a reply: "Kisses." She's stunned — eight years married and suddenly he's being sweet. She texts back: "Love you too, honey, kisses" and all that. He replies: "Idiot, I meant the chicken — whole or just the legs?"

A patient asks: "Doc, I know the test results — just tell me straight, how much time do I have left?" The doctor, still scribbling on his clipboard: "Ten..." The patient, going pale: "Ten what?!" The doctor: "Nine..."
God, if you made us in your own image, then please explain why we needed nerves in our teeth?

Kids these days: "Wanna go to the beach, honey?" "Nah, too hot out." Meanwhile back when I was a kid, I'd come home covered head to toe in mud. "Where on earth were you?" "Swimming in the swamp... oh, and Lyokha drowned, by the way."
The mattress won't fit in the trunk, there's no rope, zero plan for transport — but the family loads it up anyway, held on by pure faith. The important thing is believing it'll make it.
Female talent: at 6:50 look like you just crawled out of a grave, and by 7:10 be ready for a magazine cover.

I love early spring! You're walking around in a puffer jacket, while some girl runs past in a leather jacket, a dress, and sandals, a fancy lady struts by in a fur coat, and somewhere in the distance an old man is sunbathing in his underwear!

Moms today: here, sweetie, hold the digital thermometer, thirty seconds and we're done, you won't even feel it. My mom back in the day: hold this mercury thermometer and remember — break it, and we all die.
A husband and wife are watching a horror movie. A witch pops up on screen. The wife shrieks, "Oh my god, mom!" The husband calmly replies, "Recognized your relative, huh?"
Sitting on social media one evening, bored out of my mind... and suddenly — bam! A famous Hollywood actor from a random country sends me a friend request!

I'm allergic to pollen. Standing outside without my meds, everything blooming, eyes watering like crazy. A cute guy walks up and asks why I'm crying. So I made up this whole sob story about getting dumped. That's how we met. Three years later we got married, and I finally admitted I made it all up just to keep talking to him. He just smiled and said, "Yeah, I knew that from the start."
This seagull saved a driver from a fine — it landed right in front of the speed camera and blocked the license plate.
During surgery, a doctor asks his colleague: "Hey, what even is this thing?" "No clue — in the textbook every organ was labeled, but not this one."

If this isn't love, then what is?

Nastya texts: "I won't beat around the bush — I met a man. His name is Boris, and he's wonderful. This is hard to say, but I think I've fallen for him. I promised to always be honest with you, so here it is."

Her boyfriend replies: "Nastya, have you lost your mind?! We already have two cats!" — "Fine, fine, let me show you."

She sends a photo of a cat named Boris.

"Mind if I ask how long you've been married?" "Eight years." "Survived a renovation together?" "Three moves, two renovations, and now we're thinking about building a house." "Wow, that's one solid marriage."
A woman comes in for a checkup. The doctor asks, "So what's wrong?" She hesitates: "Oh, nothing really…" He replies, "Look, I'm your doctor, not your husband — you can actually tell me."

"Dad, when I grow up, will I be as pretty as you?"
"Well, I think you'll be as pretty as mom."
"No way, being pretty like mom takes forever! First cream, then mascara, then lipstick, then hair..."
"But you get up, wash your face, and you're already gorgeous!"
When you're watching a romantic movie but stopped believing in love ages ago: just push her off.

At my military medical exam they asked me the difference between salt and sugar. I explained that salt is a mineral and sugar is a complex organic compound. They almost sent me for a psych evaluation. Turns out everyone else just said one's salty and the other's sweet.
Come to my place, I'll show you what an experienced girl can do — cut to rows of homemade pickle jars.

I had a daughter and wanted to name her Eva. My mom immediately objected: "Don't be silly, she should be Lenochka." My mother-in-law pushed for something "prettier," like Angelika. My husband got fed up with the whole debate and went to the registry office alone. When he came back, we asked him, "So, who won — Eva, Lena, or Angela?" He said, "None of them! I named her Tasya, Taisiya." I was stunned: "We never even talked about that!" He explained, "I figured it out — you're Tanya, I'm Vasya, so our daughter is Tasya. Isn't that cool?" I was a little sad it wasn't Eva, but then I thought, "Well, my husband came up with that all on his own." Our little Tasya just turned three, and I can't imagine her being called anything else.
A doctor tells his patient: "I have two pieces of bad news for you." "Oh no, what are they?" "You have four days left to live." "And the other one?" "I was supposed to tell you that four days ago."

"Honey, I really feel like something's missing with you."
"Aww, that's so sweet)"
"No, seriously, something's missing?"
"Yeah. Should we get another girlfriend?"
If you're going to mess something up, do it in a way that leaves everyone standing there wondering, "How on earth did he pull that off?!"
The therapist asks, "So what brings you here?" The woman replies, "I'm a mom of three. I just came to lie down in silence for a bit."
This garage is perfect if your motorcycle has a sidecar. Just remember to let the passenger out of the sidecar before you drive in.

An old lady bought a pair of galoshes at the market. Walking past a pharmacy, she spotted a stack of empty boxes set out for the trash, grabbed one that fit, and tucked her galoshes inside. On the bus, box on her lap, a young guy sitting across from her reads the label: "Condoms — 2000 count." He asks, "Grandma, who needs all that rubber?" Confused how he'd know about the galoshes, she says, "For my husband." He asks, "How long will that last him?" She shrugs, "Depends how hard he rubs — could wear out in a week."
There's a guy in America who climbs a 610-meter tower once every six months just to change a lightbulb. And for that, he gets paid $20,000.
Out of old habit, Rosa tried to put on airs like a beauty queen — problem is, the materials she was built from have seen better days.
"We just wanted to bake a hedgehog cake before the guests arrived" — what came out looked more like a disaster on a plate.
This is me after a rough day, putting on a true crime show about serial killers just to calm my nerves a little

I went to shower at 1am and left my work laptop on. My cat opened Skype and texted my boss: "asdf". That wasn't dramatic enough for her, so she called him too. He figured if someone calls that late it must be serious, so he picked up. The first thing he saw was a fluffy cat butt in full, glorious detail (they even sent me a screenshot as a keepsake). Then the cat bumped her nose against the camera, typed "pfft", and hung up herself.
So THAT's who's been handing out all the discount stickers on the meat!

Was in a taxi recently and watched a whole soap opera unfold over the phone. The driver picks up:
— Hello, why are you crying?
— You called me and got upset?
— Oh, you couldn't get through and that's why you're crying?!
— So you actually talked to me and you're still crying?!
— Wait, you called me, got the wrong number, got upset you didn't reach me, and now you're crying?!
— So somehow this is MY fault?!
My wife asked me to get the kid some bubbles. Now dad and his buddy are the ones blowing them nonstop while the toddler just watches. Everyone's happy though!
They built a soccer field on top of a mountain: now if you miss the goal, you're chasing the ball all the way down to the bottom!

My cat is basically a volunteer rescuer: every month he drags home one or two kittens, just a couple months old, and I'm the one stuck bathing them and finding them homes. I figured maybe they were his own kids, but the other day he showed up with a husky puppy — clearly swiped from somewhere nearby, dropped it off looking very proud of himself, and strutted off. One day I come home and there are three kittens of different ages, one of them Siamese. I warned him: bring home one more and I'm turning you in along with your loot. For three days straight he's been eating in silence and facing the wall — sees me, turns away too, even sleeps like that. Guess he's giving me the silent treatment now.
There's a sign on the gate: "Warning! The dog is vicious, and the cat is straight-up unhinged!" Below it — a photo of that very cat sitting with an axe in its paws, captioned: "Welcome!"

Grandma and her granddaughter are having tea at the summer house. There's a jar of jam on the table, with ants crawling toward it from every direction. Without a second thought, the girl squishes one with her finger. Grandma tries to guilt-trip her: "Lizzy, how could you? Ants are alive too, it hurts them, they have kids waiting at home... and now their mom's never coming back..." Liza, squashing the next ant: "And their dad's not coming back either!"
Back in school my classmates all had big plans: "I'll be a businessman," "I'll be a manager," "And I'll be a footballer." Fast forward to now, and every single one of them drives for a rideshare app.
A week after buying an exercise bike, it becomes the sturdiest clothes rack in the house.
Bought my wife some eyebrow gel because the reviews were good. Honestly, I know nothing about eyebrows, but she's happy — which almost never happens. Bottom line: she hasn't smacked me in four days.

At a party, a famous writer shook hands with a snooty aristocrat on his way out. The aristocrat sneered, "Memory failing you, my good man? We already said goodbye five minutes ago." The writer smiled, "True, but saying goodbye to you was so delightful I just had to do it twice."
When someone's explaining the same thing to you for the seventh time and you still don't get it, but they don't lose their cool and just keep explaining: "Thanks" — "Sorry for being dumb as a brick".

Two friends went out for a girls' night, had way too much at the bar, and were stumbling home tipsy when their stomachs suddenly betrayed them right next to a cemetery. One used her own underwear as tissue, the other tore a ribbon off a nearby funeral wreath. The next morning one furious husband calls another: "You won't believe it, mine came home dead drunk with no underwear on!" "That's nothing! Mine came home wasted too, and stuck to her backside was a note that said: 'We will never forget you. Station 12 Fire Brigade.'"

My cat literally watches TV with me and has an opinion on everything. Some trashy reality show comes on — he shakes his head like he's embarrassed for humanity. A horror movie starts — he jumps into my arms and trembles at the scary parts. During a comedy he lies next to me and I swear I hear him chuckle. And during commercials he runs to his litter box or grabs himself a snack. Pretty sure this little guy is about to evolve into a person.
First you're young and full of dreams, and then one day you catch yourself genuinely admiring something like this:
Grandma lost her grandson in the plumbing store. When she finally found him sitting on a display toilet, she just pretended he wasn't hers.
So that's how I met your mother, kids: I saw her carrying four beers at once and fell in love on the spot.

A small, timid-looking woman in glasses walks into the circus director's office. "I want to be your tiger tamer!" The director, barely holding back a laugh, says, "See those tigers going wild in the cage? Go calm them down." She calmly steps into the cage and suddenly bellows at the top of her lungs: "ALRIGHT, YOU BEASTS, SETTLE DOWN!" The tigers practically dropped to the floor in shock, one even wet itself. The stunned director asks, "Did you do that at your last job too?" "Yes, but there I added one more thing." "What was that?" "...seventh-grade homeroom..."

My 3-year-old daughter begs again: "Mom, let's play!" So I play however I can, as long as everyone's having fun. I rolled a ring out of a wet wipe and lined up two armies of toys facing each other. One side yells: "We must carry the ring to Mordor!" The other yells: "We're classmates, we're a squad!" In the end, a rubber bath pig snatched the ring and shrieked: "Mine! My precious!" My 11-year-old son doesn't join in, he just sits there cracking up at us.
Want to catch a cockroach? Start thinking like a cockroach.
A boy runs home shouting, "Mom, there are naked people in the hayloft!" "Those must just be wild people, son." "Well, the lady might be wild, but our dad is definitely tame!"
My mom yells for me from another room like the house is on fire. I sprint over, heart pounding, ready for an emergency. And she goes: "Hand me the remote"

My daughter is 6. She packed her kindergarten stuff and, out of pure principle, refused to put it in a bag — carried it all in her bare hands. In freezing cold! "Dad, my hands are frozen! Dad, my hands are frozen!" She said it about ten times until I gave in and took her stuff. She immediately ran off happily to pry an icicle off a pipe. Remember, folks: kids have been exploiting us since the day they were born.
You stand there staring at the building like, "Balcony, where are you?" Turns out it just moved down a floor — "I'm right here!"

My back was killing me one night, so I got up to stretch it out — did some bends, tried a backbend, nothing helped. Figured I'd walk around a bit in the backbend position, went out to the hallway and came back. The second I walked back into the room, my husband woke up. I have never heard him scream like that in my life. Turns out he woke up, I wasn't in bed, and something bent over backwards on all fours was creeping through the doorway groaning. Now he's convinced I'm a witch who walks on walls.
Had to leave town for a bit and left my cat with a friend. He sent the first photo of the cat's breakfast at the new place — pure art.
Every evening on my way home from work, I feel a deep spiritual bond with this particular mannequin.
Who decides what time you wake up on your day off? The neighbor with the weed trimmer right under your window. — Already happening, under every window in the country.

A student once asked an old cosmonaut during a lecture what exactly made Gagarin's flight so heroic. The cosmonaut sighed and said: ever seen a ten-story building? Now imagine that whole thing is fuel, and you're sitting at the very top in a tiny capsule. And down below, they light it up saying, "Don't worry, we did the math, you'll definitely come back!"
At a dance, a guy asks a girl, "Why are you dancing so fast? The song is slow!" She replies, "I've got no time — quick dance, then home!"
The doctor asks the patient, "What's wrong?" She grumbles, "Nothing." The doctor snaps, "Idiot, I'm your doctor."

One day I took my kids to the local farm, and we found a baby goat with its horns stuck in the fence, sitting sadly in the grass. We tried to free it, petted it, and fed it some grass, then went to the ticket counter to warn them it needed help. Before I could get past "there's a goat...", the guy waved his hand tiredly and said, "Yeah, we know. That's Brenda. She gets stuck in the fence whenever she wants attention, and frees herself whenever she's bored of it." Damn manipulative goat.

A guy brings three girls home and tells his mom: "Guess which one is my fiancée." Without missing a beat, mom points: "That one, on the end." "How'd you know?" "She's the one who started annoying me first."
One look at her from behind and I was out cold. What a gorgeous chick!
The boy comes home covered in mud with his little friend and says: "Don't worry, mom! I'll wash her off, dry her, comb her hair — and marry her!"
"Grandson, what are you up to?" "I'm on Facebook, grandma, you wouldn't get it." "Oh, wouldn't I? That 'Sweet Baby Lala' in your friend list — that's me!"

Every summer as a kid I'd visit my grandma in the countryside, where Vaska was always waiting for me — a completely unhinged goose who'd decided that hating me was his life's purpose. Ever fought a goose? Highly recommend it, an experience you'll never forget. On the plus side, I never lost a single school fight afterward, and bullies just left me alone — you basically can't beat someone who's been battle-tested by a psychotic goose.
Looking at this pepper, I honestly don't know whether to toss it straight into the soup or ask it first if everything's okay.
On a bus, two women are shouting at a drunk guy: "I'll show you!" — "I'll give it to you!" The guy replies: "Honestly, I can't decide which one of you to pick."

"Why does your daughter make mistakes in her dictations — and throw in swear words too?"
"What do you expect — she's trying hard, gets nervous, messes up, and then starts cursing."
On the work video call, up top it's all suit and tie. But under the table: shorts, Christmas socks, a hookah, and a couple of beers.
My wife tidied up the shoe rack and sorted everything into perfect pairs. Except one "pair" somehow ended up being two completely different boots.
When you're sneaky but still loyal
When the power's cut but you still want hot food — this is how we roll: kettle stuffed to the brim with dumplings. Say what you want, but hunger's not gonna beat us!
A hen left footprints all over the freshly poured concrete in the yard. The verdict was swift and merciless — the very next day she was on the table, golden-roasted and garnished with lemon.
"What happened?" "Everyone at work got their brains fried today." Then, grinning: "Wait, seriously? They didn't save any for me?"
Our body is at its weakest between 3 and 4 a.m. — that's exactly when people are most likely to die in their sleep. So just to be safe, I only go to bed after 4.

"Be honest, am I fat?"
"No."
"But losing a few pounds wouldn't hurt?"
"You're in great shape."
"Just maybe trim the hips a little?"
"I love you no matter what."
"But not head over heels?"
"I'm crazy about you!"
"But not out-of-your-mind crazy?"
"So there's going to be a fight either way, right?"
Every year, fashionable outfits look more and more like scarecrows.
Now THAT is what I call a perfectly organized garage!
I love playing a little game called "sleep roulette": I go to bed and don't set an alarm. Will I wake up in 20 minutes, 4 hours, or two days? Nobody knows. That's real adrenaline right there.
There's a note taped to the shop door: "Stepped out! Back when I'm back!!!" Flawless logic — can't argue with that.
Me, standing at the bus stop in freezing cold weather. Meanwhile the taxi driver right next to me just quietly waits for my patience to run out.
Ordered shoes online — got exactly what you'd expect: one shoe like the picture, the other one... an interpretation.

It's summer, and I bought new sandals that rubbed my feet raw. I go into the pharmacy for a band-aid, and there's a line. To kill time, I start browsing the display case. When it's finally my turn, I blurt out without thinking: "How much are the birth control pills?" The pharmacist says, "Well... it depends, 300, 500, 800..." I go, "Got it. In that case just give me a whole roll of band-aid tape." The pharmacist lost it laughing so hard her glasses nearly fell off. I still haven't been back to that pharmacy since.
Nurse: I have wonderful news — you'll be seeing your husband again very soon! Grandma: But he's been dead for years. Nurse: Exactly.

"I've got my own pleasure room. Want to see it?"
...
Turns out it's just a greenhouse full of tomatoes and herbs.
At the station, a husband sees his wife off on vacation: "Take it easy out there, okay?" "Got it — I'll take it easy giving it up!"
Dad's convinced the fish in that lake know his old lure by heart. How do you think they'll react when he shows up with it again? — "Ugh, my god, how embarrassing."
In college they teach you to stroll through life all calm and confident. In real life an angry goose just attacks you and you're sprinting for your life.

Touching story: a Japanese man traveled abroad and stumbled upon the very same car he'd scrapped for metal a quarter century earlier. Funny thing — the mileage was now three times lower than it used to be.
A patient tells the doctor: "Every morning at exactly 8 a.m. I go number two." The doctor asks, "So what's the problem?" The patient replies: "The problem is I wake up at 9."

A friend of mine found his own bike listed for sale on the Swedish version of Craigslist — the one that hadn't even been stolen yet. Turns out the thieves post photos straight from the bike room and only actually steal it once they've found a buyer. Now that's what I call process optimization.

"How's it going, Jen?" "They took Kevin to the hospital, cut out his appendix." "What's that thing anyway?" "Some kind of little growth, down below his belly." "Oh no, honey... however will you two manage now?"
— Honey, do you love me? — Of course! — Would you die for me? — No way! Then who'd be left to love you?
She's bragging to her friends: "He picks me up every morning and even opens the door for me." ... Turns out she means the city bus.
At first I thought her pants had fallen down. Turns out those are just her boots.

Whenever coworkers ask, "So where are you headed on vacation this time?" I start suspecting their paycheck is bigger than mine. So I lean over to my desk neighbor and whisper: "Wait, are we actually paid the same?"

Depression keeps tipping the house over a little more every day. Memes are the wooden beam holding the roof up. And I'm the poor guy holding that beam with everything I've got so it doesn't all collapse.

"My husband finally quit drinking!"
"No way! How?"
"Our pet squirrel stole dishes from the dollhouse, and the first thing he saw opening his eyes was her standing there holding a little tray like a waiter."
When someone guilt-trips you for not calling your family enough, just remember: they have your number too.
Meet Fluffy — my personal taste-tester. Every morning he heroically eats my porridge so I don't have to!
Me: getting ready for bed. Random fly that just flew in: "And now for my next number, bzzz-bzzz-bzzz." If she'd just sing, fine — but no, she's dancing on your face too.
The doctor asks, "Where does it hurt?" The patient says, "It really hurts when I poke it right here!" The doctor replies, "Then stop poking it." Then adds, "That'll be 15,000."
Today a guy messaged me: "Babe, what are you wearing?" Without missing a beat, I replied: "A mortgage, two murders, and a robbery." He still hasn't answered, the jerk!

The most painless death in the world is standing at ground zero of a thermonuclear blast — the radiation kills you before the pain signal even reaches your brain. One second you're there, the next you're gone. Probably why downtown real estate is so expensive.
Why argue with your neighbor when you can just grow a bush... in the right shape
